label: 의심을 끝까지 파고든다
label_en: Dig into the doubt to the end
success_text: 의심을 파고들어 오히려 신앙의 근거를 다시 세웁니다.
success_text_en: Digging into your doubt, you rebuild the very foundation of your faith.
fail_text_en: Your doubt only deepens, and you toss and turn all night.

label: 더 깊이 기도한다
success_text_en: As you lose yourself in prayer, your heart settles.
fail_text_en: You pray, but no answer comes. You feel hollow.

label: 측근에게 고민을 털어놓는다
success_text_en: Your confidant comforts you and prays with you.

label: 신도들에게 계시를 알린다
label_en: Announce the Revelation to your followers
success_text: 계시 이야기가 입소문을 타고 신도들이 몰려듭니다.
success_text_en: Word of the Revelation spreads, and followers flock to you.
fail_text_en: Rumors spread that it's preposterous.

label: 혼자 간직한다
success_text_en: You keep it quietly and steady your heart.

label: 꿈일 뿐이라 여긴다
success_text_en: Telling yourself it was only a dream, you set it aside.

label: 계시를 교리로 정리한다
success_text_en: You refine the words of the dream into Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The words are too vague to set down.

label: 신도들에게 계시의 대가로 헌금을 요구한다
success_text_en: You collect offerings in the name of the Revelation.
fail_text_en: Your followers push back against the demand.

label: 사흘 금식한다
success_text_en: After three days of fasting, your mind is clear.
fail_text_en: Your strength gives out and you collapse.

label: 하루만 한다
success_text_en: A single day of fasting steadies your mind.

label: 신도들과 함께 금식한다
success_text_en: Going hungry together binds your followers tighter.
fail_text_en: Your followers grumble with hunger.

label: 몰래 음식을 먹는다
success_text: 몰래 먹은 음식에 죄책감이 들지만 허기는 가십니다.
success_text_en: You feel guilty about the food you sneaked, but your hunger fades.
fail_text_en: A follower catches you, and word gets around.

label: 그를 공개적으로 비판한다
success_text_en: You are praised as a voice of justice.
fail_text_en: You are slammed for tearing down a fellow clergyman.

label: 그를 감싼다
success_text_en: When you defend him, followers leave.
fail_text_en: Because you defended him, the cult falls under suspicion too.

label: 그의 몰락에서 교훈을 얻는다
success_text_en: Taking the lesson to heart, you steady your faith.

label: 그의 신도들을 흡수한다
success_text_en: You take in the followers who have nowhere to go.
fail_text_en: Other cults protest the takeover.

label: 신의 징표라 믿는다
label_en: Believe it is a sign from God
success_text_en: Believing it a sign, your confidence grows.
fail_text_en: The sign fades, and you grow uneasy.

label: 기분 탓이라 넘긴다
success_text_en: You let it pass calmly.

label: 신도의 아픈 곳에 손을 얹어 본다
label_en: Lay your hands on a follower's ailment
success_text_en: The ailing follower smiles again.
fail_text_en: Nothing happens, and the follower is disappointed.

label: 밤새 연구한다
success_text: 밤새 연구해 경전의 숨은 뜻을 찾아냅니다.
success_text_en: Studying through the night, you uncover the scripture's hidden meaning.
fail_text_en: The study goes nowhere, and you only wear yourself down.

label: 설교에 바로 쓴다
label_en: Use it in a sermon right away
success_text_en: You use it in a sermon, and your followers are moved.
fail_text_en: You are criticized for a shallow interpretation.

label: 당신만의 해석으로 숨겨 둔다
success_text_en: You keep its meaning to yourself.

label: 병상에서도 기도를 멈추지 않는다
success_text: 병상의 기도가 신의 뜻으로 여겨져 신도들이 감동합니다.
success_text_en: Your sickbed prayers are taken as God's will, and your followers are moved.
fail_text_en: You collapse mid-prayer and are laid up again.

label: 신도들의 간호를 받는다
success_text_en: Your followers take turns nursing you.

label: 신을 원망한다
success_text_en: Resentment toward God wells up in you.
fail_text_en: Your resentment leaks out to your followers.

label: 의사를 부른다
success_text_en: The doctor's treatment speeds your recovery.

label: 한 달 동안 떠난다
success_text_en: A month of ascetic practice steels your heart.
fail_text_en: The cult wavers, and followers dwindle.

label: 거절하고 교단을 지킨다
success_text: 교단 곁을 지키며 신도들의 신뢰를 얻습니다.
success_text_en: Staying by the cult's side, you win your followers' trust.

label: 신의 응답이라 선포한다
success_text_en: Rumor spreads through the neighborhood that God has answered.
fail_text_en: Rebuttals pour in calling it coincidence.

label: 조용히 감사한다
success_text_en: You offer a quiet prayer of thanks.

label: 우연이라 생각한다
success_text_en: Deeming it coincidence, you let it pass calmly.

label: 정면으로 토론한다
success_text: 논리로 수행자를 꺾어 주변의 박수를 받습니다.
success_text_en: You defeat the practitioner with logic and earn the crowd's applause.
fail_text_en: You lose ground in the debate, and onlookers jeer.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: A polite refusal preserves your dignity.

label: 그의 가르침을 배운다
success_text_en: You gain new insight from his teachings.
fail_text_en: The other doctrine leaves you confused.

label: 신도들 앞에서 그를 조롱한다
success_text_en: Your followers chime in with laughter.
fail_text_en: The mockery backfires and dents your Repute.

label: 초심으로 돌아가 기도한다
label_en: Return to your roots in prayer
success_text_en: Praying as you did at the start, you find your heart again.
fail_text_en: You pray, but the emptiness won't lift.

label: 휴식을 취한다
success_text_en: Rest restores your strength.

label: 쾌락으로 공허를 채운다
success_text_en: Lost in pleasure, you forget the emptiness for a while.
fail_text_en: Your indulgence comes to light, and your followers are disappointed.

label: 일에 더 몰두한다
success_text: 일에 몰두하며 교단 살림이 조금 나아집니다.
success_text_en: Throwing yourself into work, the cult's finances improve a little.
fail_text_en: Overwork takes its toll on your body.

label: 고향을 찾아간다
success_text_en: At your hometown church, you rediscover the roots of your heart.
fail_text_en: No one is left in your hometown.

label: 과거와 단절하기로 한다
success_text_en: You put the past behind you and focus on the cult.

label: 교단의 번영을 빈다
success_text_en: Wishing for the cult's prosperity, you steady your resolve.

label: 신도들의 안녕을 빈다
success_text_en: Wishing for your followers warms your heart.
fail_text_en: Your wish scatters into thin air.

label: 신을 직접 만나게 해 달라고 빈다
label_en: Wish to meet God face to face
success_text_en: Your fervent wish sets your heart aflame.
fail_text_en: The wish goes unanswered, leaving you deflated.

label: 아무것도 빌지 않는다
success_text_en: Wishing for nothing, you gaze at the stars.

label: 측근을 불러 진심을 보여 준다
label_en: Summon him and show your sincerity
success_text_en: Seeing your sincerity, your confidant bows his head.
fail_text_en: Your words come out awkward, and his distrust deepens.

label: 측근을 내쫓는다
success_text_en: Casting him out sets the cult abuzz.
fail_text_en: The man you cast out spreads rumors.

label: 흔들리지 않는 척 연기한다
success_text_en: Your calm act keeps your inner circle in line.
fail_text_en: Your act is exposed, and trust collapses.

label: 스스로를 돌아본다
success_text_en: Reflecting on yourself, you renew your resolve.

label: 신의 분노라 해석하고 참회한다
label_en: Read it as God's wrath and repent
success_text_en: Followers gather in tears for a service of repentance.
fail_text_en: Talk of wrath frightens outsiders.

label: 신의 축복이라 선포한다
success_text_en: At the word "blessing," your followers cheer.
fail_text_en: Critics blast you for calling a disaster a blessing.

label: 피뢰침을 설치한다
success_text_en: The neighbors admire your sensible measure.

label: 전생을 교리에 담는다
label_en: Write past lives into the Doctrine
success_text: 전생 이야기가 교리의 한 장이 됩니다.
success_text_en: The tale of past lives becomes a chapter of the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: Word goes around that the past-life story is absurd.

label: 신도들에게 이야기한다
success_text_en: Your followers listen with bated breath.
fail_text_en: The story gets exaggerated and becomes a joke.

label: 홀로 깊이 묵상한다
success_text_en: Meditating alone, you compose yourself.

label: 행동으로 보이는 것이라 답한다
label_en: Answer that faith is shown through deeds
success_text: 행동하는 믿음을 강조해 노인이 고개를 끄덕입니다.
success_text_en: You stress faith in action, and the old man nods.

label: 의심하지 않는 것이라 답한다
label_en: Answer that it is never doubting
success_text_en: The old man quietly bows his head.
fail_text_en: The old man's face darkens.

label: 모르겠다고 솔직히 답한다
success_text_en: The old man smiles at your honest answer.

label: 노인을 신도로 만든다
label_en: Make the old man a follower
success_text_en: The old man becomes a follower and prays with you.
fail_text_en: The old man leaves with some harsh words.

label: 아름다운 운율로 짓는다
success_text_en: The verse is so beautiful your followers recite along.
fail_text_en: Fixated on rhythm, you blur the meaning.

label: 짧고 강렬하게 짓는다
success_text_en: The short prayer spreads from mouth to mouth.
fail_text_en: Some say it's too short and feels empty.

label: 신도들과 함께 짓는다
success_text_en: Your followers pool their ideas to complete the prayer.

label: 새벽까지 기도한다
success_text_en: Praying until dawn soothes your anxiety.

label: 악몽을 신의 시험이라 여긴다
label_en: Take the nightmare as God's test
success_text_en: Calling it a test, you steady yourself.
fail_text_en: The word "test" weighs heavily on you.

label: 측근에게 해몽을 맡긴다
label_en: Have your inner circle interpret it
success_text_en: Your followers are reassured by the interpretation.
fail_text_en: The interpretations conflict, sowing confusion.

label: 술로 잊는다
success_text_en: You try to forget the nightmare with drink.
fail_text_en: Word of your heavy drinking spreads, and you lose trust.

label: 직접 가족을 설득한다
success_text_en: You win over the family, and the follower stays.
fail_text_en: Persuasion fails, and the conflict with the family grows.

label: 떠나도록 축복해 준다
success_text: 축복받고 떠난 신도가 교단에 호감을 갖습니다.
success_text_en: Leaving with your blessing, the follower thinks well of the cult.
fail_text_en: The departing follower's back looks lonely.

label: 떠나면 저주받는다고 경고한다
label_en: Warn that leaving brings a curse
success_text_en: Your followers cower at the warning.
fail_text_en: Word of the threat spreads, and your Repute falls.

label: 교단 숙소를 제공한다
success_text_en: With lodging provided, the follower stays.

label: 함께 눈물을 흘린다
success_text_en: Weeping together, you share your followers' hearts.

label: 감동적인 설교로 마무리한다
success_text_en: Your followers are deeply moved by the sermon.
fail_text_en: The sermon falls flat, and the mood cools.

label: 헌금 바구니를 돌린다
success_text_en: The offering basket fills up.
fail_text_en: Some followers are put off by the offering basket.

label: 양쪽 이야기를 모두 듣는다
success_text_en: Hearing both sides, you broker a reconciliation.

label: 한쪽 편을 든다
success_text: 한쪽 편을 들자 다른 쪽이 떠납니다.
success_text_en: When you take one side, the other leaves.
fail_text_en: Even the side you backed turns away.

label: 둘 다 꾸짖는다
success_text_en: Rebuking both brings silence.
fail_text_en: Hurt followers grow quiet.

label: 교리로 해답을 제시한다
label_en: Offer an answer from the Doctrine
success_text_en: A single passage of the Doctrine eases the conflict.
fail_text_en: The Doctrine is misread, and the conflict deepens.

label: 기꺼이 받는다
success_text: 큰 헌금이 교단의 살림을 넉넉하게 합니다.
success_text_en: The large offering fills the cult's coffers.
fail_text_en: Rumors that you took his fortune turn ugly.

label: 일부만 받는다
success_text_en: You accept only part, preserving the follower's livelihood.

label: 거절하고 돌려보낸다
success_text_en: Worried for his livelihood, you send him away.
fail_text_en: The follower is disappointed to have it returned.

label: 받아서 가난한 신도들에게 나눈다
label_en: Accept it and share it with poor followers
success_text_en: Your generosity wins your followers' hearts.
fail_text_en: Some say you give it away too freely.

label: 재산을 받아 교단 명의로 불린다
label_en: Accept it and grow it in the cult's name
success_text_en: Investing in the cult's name grows the fortune.
fail_text_en: The investment fails, and your followers are furious.

label: 기쁘게 받아들인다
success_text_en: Your followers' devotion warms your heart.

label: 검소하게 하자고 한다
label_en: Ask them to keep it modest
success_text_en: Your followers respect your modesty.

label: 생일 대신 봉사의 날로 바꾼다
label_en: Turn your birthday into a day of service
success_text_en: On the day of service, neighbors express their thanks.
fail_text_en: Your followers are disappointed.

label: 잔치를 크게 벌인다
success_text_en: The feast heightens your followers' joy.
fail_text_en: Critics say the feast cost too much.

label: 칭찬하고 격려한다
success_text_en: The child proudly carries on with the sermon.

label: 교주를 흉내 내지 말라 꾸짖는다
label_en: Scold them for imitating the cult leader
success_text_en: The child shrinks back and falls silent.
fail_text_en: The child bursts into tears, and the adults stir.

label: 손을 얹고 기도한다
label_en: Lay hands on him and pray
success_text: 기도 끝에 신도의 숨이 조금 편안해집니다.
success_text_en: After the prayer, the follower breathes a little easier.
fail_text_en: The prayer has no effect, and the follower is disappointed.

label: 병원에 가라고 권한다
label_en: Urge him to see a doctor
success_text_en: His family thanks you for the advice to seek treatment.

label: 기적을 약속한다
success_text_en: Promised a miracle, the follower clings to hope.
fail_text_en: The promise goes unkept, and word gets around.

label: 치료비를 교단이 대 준다
label_en: Have the cult pay for treatment
success_text: 치료비를 대 주자 신도가 평생 감사합니다.
success_text_en: The follower is grateful for life that you paid his bills.
fail_text_en: The treatment costs more than expected.

label: 간증을 집회에서 나누게 한다
label_en: Have him share his testimony at the gathering
success_text_en: Hearing the testimony, your followers are moved.
fail_text_en: Word goes around that the testimony is exaggerated.

label: 과장이라며 자제시킨다
success_text_en: Your calm demeanor inspires trust.

label: 그 꿈을 교리에 넣는다
label_en: Write the dream into the Doctrine
success_text_en: The dream becomes a scene in the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: Critics say it makes the Doctrine fanciful.

label: 규율을 완화한다
success_text_en: Your followers are relieved when the rules are loosened.

label: 규율을 더 강화한다
success_text_en: Under stricter rules, your followers hold their breath.
fail_text_en: The backlash leaks outside.

label: 엄격함의 의미를 설교한다
label_en: Preach on the meaning of strictness
success_text_en: Your followers accept the sermon.
fail_text_en: The sermon sounds like nagging.

label: 불평한 신도를 찾아낸다
success_text_en: You find the complainers and make an example of them.
fail_text_en: Followers threaten to leave en masse.

label: 성대한 장례를 치른다
success_text_en: Villagers gather for the funeral.
fail_text_en: The heavy cost shakes the finances.

label: 그의 삶을 교리 속 본보기로 남긴다
label_en: Enshrine his life as an example in the Doctrine
success_text_en: His life becomes an example in the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: Some say it's excessive glorification.

label: 유족을 평생 돌보겠다 약속한다
label_en: Promise to care for his family for life
success_text_en: Your followers are moved when you make the promise to the bereaved.

label: 유산을 교단에 귀속시킨다
label_en: Claim his estate for the cult
success_text_en: The cult receives the estate.
fail_text_en: A legal battle breaks out with the bereaved family.

label: 직접 작사한다
success_text: 직접 지은 노래에 신도들이 따라 부릅니다.
success_text_en: Your followers sing along to the song you wrote.
fail_text_en: The lyrics are so awkward people laugh.

label: 신도들에게 맡긴다
success_text_en: Your followers come up with songs of their own.

label: 기존 노래를 개사한다
label_en: Rewrite the words of an existing song
success_text_en: The familiar tune spreads quickly.
fail_text_en: Plagiarism accusations arise.

label: 노래 따위 필요 없다고 한다
success_text_en: You pray without singing.
fail_text_en: Your followers feel something is missing.

label: 해명한다
success_text_en: Your calm explanation quiets the rumors.
fail_text_en: Your explanation sounds like an excuse.

label: 소문을 낸 신도를 용서한다
label_en: Forgive the follower who spread it
success_text_en: Your forgiveness wins your followers' hearts.

label: 소문을 낸 신도를 추방한다
label_en: Expel the follower who spread it
success_text_en: The expulsion restores discipline.
fail_text_en: Word goes around that expulsion was too harsh.

label: 소문을 신비감으로 이용한다
label_en: Use the rumor to build mystique
success_text_en: The rumor only deepens your mystique.
fail_text_en: The rumor hardens into accepted fact.

label: 허락한다
success_text_en: Your followers grow more united.
fail_text_en: The cult's image suffers.

label: 금지한다
success_text_en: Your prudent decision protects your Repute.
fail_text_en: Many followers are disappointed by the ban.

label: 팔찌로 대신하게 한다
success_text_en: Your followers are delighted as you hand out bracelets.

label: 직접 신도들을 깨우러 다닌다
success_text_en: Moved that you came for them in person, followers return.
fail_text_en: The punishing schedule takes its toll on your body.

label: 출석을 강제한다
success_text_en: Attendance rises, but resentment builds.

label: 기도회 시간을 옮긴다
success_text_en: After the time change, they gather again.
fail_text_en: The new time only causes more confusion.

label: 빠진 신도들의 사정을 듣는다
success_text: 사정을 들어 준 덕분에 신도들이 마음을 엽니다.
success_text_en: Because you listened, your followers open up.
fail_text_en: Their circumstances are tangled and hard to resolve.

label: 교단의 성인 이름을 준다
label_en: Give the name of a cult saint
success_text_en: The couple is delighted with the saint's name.

label: 정성껏 의미를 담아 짓는다
label_en: Choose a name full of meaning
success_text_en: The couple is moved by the meaningful name.

label: 받아들인다
success_text_en: Your followers revere you like a god.
fail_text_en: Accusations of blasphemy pour in.

label: 단호히 부정한다
success_text_en: Your firm denial protects your Repute.

label: 애매하게 넘긴다
success_text_en: Your ambiguity only makes your followers more fervent.
fail_text_en: Your ambiguity breeds suspicion.

label: 신의 대리인일 뿐이라 정정한다
label_en: Correct them: you are only God's agent
success_text_en: Being called God's agent reassures your followers.
fail_text_en: Some followers are disappointed.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: Your polite refusal earns respect.
fail_text_en: She is hurt.

label: 받아들인다
success_text_en: You accept, and a relationship begins.
fail_text_en: The secret leaks, and the cult is shaken.

label: 신의 사랑으로 승화시키라 설교한다
label_en: Preach that she sublimate it into divine love
success_text_en: Your sermon soothes her heart.
fail_text_en: The sermon only hurts her more.

label: 신도들 모르게 관계를 이어 간다
label_en: Continue the affair behind your followers' backs
success_text: 몰래 이어 간 관계가 뜻밖에 들통나지 않습니다.
success_text_en: Against the odds, your secret affair stays hidden.
fail_text_en: The affair comes out, and the cult is thrown into uproar.

label: 함께 떠난다
success_text_en: The shared pilgrimage strengthens your followers' bond.
fail_text_en: The long road is exhausting.

label: 대표단만 보낸다
success_text_en: The delegation returns and reports.

label: 순례 대신 집회를 연다
success_text_en: Everyone prays together at the gathering.
fail_text_en: Followers who looked forward to the pilgrimage are disappointed.

label: 깊이 감사한다
success_text_en: You share your gratitude with your followers.

label: 보답으로 잔치를 연다
success_text_en: Your followers delight in the feast.
fail_text_en: The cost of the feast is a burden.

label: 공개적으로 굴복시킨다
success_text_en: Made an example of, he submits, and your inner circle falls silent.
fail_text_en: Your attempt to break him fails, and he spreads rumors.

label: 대화로 설득한다
success_text_en: You talk him around, and he yields.
fail_text_en: The talk goes nowhere.

label: 그의 의견을 일부 받아들인다
success_text_en: When you accept his views, he swears loyalty.

label: 조용히 직책에서 밀어낸다
label_en: Quietly push him out of his post
success_text_en: You quietly strip his post and bury the dispute.
fail_text_en: The ousted man spreads rumors outside.

label: 엄격한 계급제를 만든다
success_text_en: With ranks set, order takes hold.
fail_text_en: Followers passed over for rank grow resentful.

label: 모두가 평등하다고 선언한다
success_text_en: Your followers cheer the declaration of equality.
fail_text_en: The chain of command falls apart.

label: 공로에 따라 직분을 준다
success_text_en: Your followers accept ranks based on merit.

label: 당신 외엔 아무 직분도 두지 않는다
label_en: Allow no ranks but your own
success_text_en: All authority is concentrated in you.
fail_text_en: Accusations of autocracy spread.

label: 추첨으로 직분을 정한다
success_text_en: Word spreads that the lottery is fair.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise over the lottery results.

label: 솔직히 인정한다
success_text_en: Your followers respect your honest admission.

label: 깊은 뜻이 있었다고 둘러댄다
label_en: Claim there was a deeper meaning
success_text_en: Your cover story sounds convincing.
fail_text_en: It's obvious you're covering, and you become a joke.

label: 아무 일 없던 듯 넘어간다
label_en: Carry on as if nothing happened
success_text_en: You smoothly move past it.
fail_text_en: Word of your slip spreads.

label: 실수를 지적한 신도를 꾸짖는다
label_en: Scold the follower who pointed it out
success_text_en: Scolded, your followers fall silent.
fail_text_en: The scolding provokes a backlash.

label: 화려한 금빛 예복
success_text_en: The golden vestments display your majesty.
fail_text_en: Critics call it extravagant.

label: 소박한 흰 옷
success_text_en: Your followers are at ease with the simple robes.

label: 검은 망토
success_text_en: The black cloak lends an air of mystery.
fail_text_en: Some say it's oppressive.

label: 의복은 필요 없다
success_text_en: Without vestments, you emphasize the heart.

label: 공개적으로 벌한다
success_text_en: The public punishment puts your followers on edge.
fail_text_en: Word spreads that the punishment was cruel.

label: 사정을 들어 보고 용서한다
label_en: Hear him out and forgive him
success_text: 사정을 듣고 용서하자 신도가 감사를 전합니다.
success_text_en: Heard out and forgiven, the follower thanks you.

label: 조용히 따로 불러 경고한다
label_en: Call him aside and warn him quietly
success_text_en: A quiet warning restores discipline.
fail_text_en: The warning comes across as hurtful.

label: 교리에 벌칙 조항을 만든다
label_en: Write penalty clauses into the Doctrine
success_text_en: The Doctrine's clauses lend force to your orders.
fail_text_en: Controversy arises that the clauses go too far.

label: 크고 웅장한 곳으로 옮긴다
success_text_en: Followers flock to the grand venue.
fail_text_en: The rent is hard to bear.

label: 지금 자리를 지킨다
success_text_en: Your followers are reassured in the familiar place.

label: 신도의 집을 돌아가며 모인다
label_en: Meet in followers' homes by turns
success_text_en: Meeting from home to home brings your followers closer.
fail_text_en: Some say it's a hassle to gather.

label: 외딴 산속으로 옮긴다
success_text_en: In the remote mountains, the cult grows more mysterious.
fail_text_en: It's so remote that followers stop coming.

label: 경쟁을 부추긴다
success_text_en: The rivalry drives up your inner circle's loyalty.
fail_text_en: The rivalry overheats and splits them.

label: 모두를 공평하게 대한다
success_text_en: Your inner circle respects your fairness.

label: 한 명을 오른팔로 지명한다
label_en: Name one as your right hand
success_text_en: With a right hand in place, the organization runs.
fail_text_en: The rest of your inner circle is jealous.

label: 경쟁을 금지한다
success_text_en: With the rivalry gone, things grow quiet.
fail_text_en: Resentment builds after the ban.

label: 논리적으로 설명한다
success_text_en: Your followers accept your well-reasoned explanation.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise that the explanation is hard to follow.

label: 신의 뜻이라고만 답한다
label_en: Answer only that it is God's will
success_text_en: At the words "God's will," your followers obey.
fail_text_en: An answer with no explanation fuels the backlash.

label: 결정을 철회한다
success_text_en: Withdrawing it wins back your followers' trust.

label: 투표에 부친다
success_text_en: The vote confirms the decision.
fail_text_en: The vote shakes your Authority.

label: 직접 꼼꼼히 쓴다
success_text_en: A meticulous rulebook raises your Authority.
fail_text_en: So many rules cause confusion.

label: 측근들에게 맡긴다
label_en: Leave it to your inner circle
success_text_en: Your inner circle drafts the rulebook.
fail_text_en: Each confidant has different rules, causing confusion.

label: 규칙은 내 말이 곧 법이다
label_en: Declare that your word is the rule
success_text_en: Your word becomes law.
fail_text_en: Accusations of dictatorship pour in.

label: 신도들의 의견을 모아 만든다
label_en: Write it from your followers' input
success_text: 의견을 모은 규칙에 신도들이 자부심을 느낍니다.
success_text_en: Your followers take pride in rules built from their input.

label: 대등한 동맹을 맺는다
success_text_en: Followers on both sides welcome the equal alliance.
fail_text_en: A dispute breaks out over the alliance terms.

label: 흡수 합병을 요구한다
success_text: 흡수 조건에 상대가 어쩔 수 없이 따릅니다.
success_text_en: The other side has no choice but to accept your terms.
fail_text_en: Your takeover demand gets out, and criticism pours in.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You politely decline.

label: 동맹을 맺고 뒤통수를 칠 준비를 한다
label_en: Ally with him and prepare to stab him in the back
success_text: 동맹 뒤에서 상대의 신도들을 빼 옵니다.
success_text_en: Behind the alliance, you poach his followers.
fail_text_en: Your scheme is exposed, and the alliance breaks.

label: 그대로 둔다
success_text_en: The sight of them kneeling bolsters your Authority.
fail_text_en: Outsiders call it excessive worship.

label: 일으켜 세운다
success_text_en: Your followers are moved when you raise them up.

label: 신 앞에서만 꿇으라 가르친다
label_en: Teach them to kneel only before God
success_text_en: The teaching to kneel only before God spreads.
fail_text_en: Some say the teaching is confusing.

label: 무릎 꿇기를 의식으로 정한다
success_text_en: As a rite, it becomes a symbol of the cult.
fail_text_en: The excessive rite draws outsiders' glares.

label: 뱀이 검을 감은 모양
label_en: A serpent coiled around a sword
success_text_en: Your followers rave over the striking emblem.
fail_text_en: Some call it creepy.

label: 손을 맞잡은 모양
success_text_en: The warm emblem raises your Repute.

label: 눈 하나가 그려진 모양
success_text_en: The mysterious emblem captivates your followers.
fail_text_en: Word goes around that the eye is ominous.

label: 신도들에게 공모한다
success_text_en: An emblem is chosen from your followers' entries.

label: 엄벌한다
success_text_en: Severe punishment restores discipline.
fail_text_en: Some say the punishment went too far.

label: 기회를 한 번 더 준다
success_text_en: Given a chance, he is overwhelmed with gratitude.

label: 조용히 덮는다
success_text_en: Covering it up quietly prevents a scandal.
fail_text_en: The cover-up comes to light later.

label: 공개 재판을 연다
success_text: 공개 재판으로 교단이 투명하다는 인상을 줍니다.
success_text_en: The public trial makes the cult look transparent.
fail_text_en: The trial exposes the cult's internal strife.

label: 모두의 의견을 경청한다
success_text_en: Your inner circle respects your willingness to listen.

label: 결론을 미리 정해 두고 통보한다
label_en: Decide in advance and just announce it
success_text_en: Quick decisions keep the organization moving.
fail_text_en: Your inner circle balks at being told.

label: 회의를 길게 끌어 반대파를 지치게 한다
label_en: Drag the meeting out to wear down the opposition
success_text_en: The opposition wears out, and your decision goes through.
fail_text_en: The drawn-out meeting breeds discontent.

label: 회의를 생략한다
success_text_en: Your swift decision shows strength.
fail_text_en: Your inner circle turns its back on you.

label: 기꺼이 맡는다
success_text_en: Your followers are moved when you officiate.

label: 교단만의 혼례 의식을 만든다
label_en: Create a wedding rite unique to the cult
success_text_en: The cult's wedding rite becomes your followers' pride.
fail_text_en: Some say the unfamiliar rite feels awkward.

label: 측근에게 맡긴다
label_en: Leave it to your inner circle
success_text_en: Your followers accept the confidant's officiating without fuss.
fail_text_en: The confidant fumbles the ceremony and becomes a laughingstock.

label: 결혼에도 교주의 허락이 필요하다고 선언한다
label_en: Declare that marriage requires the cult leader's permission
success_text_en: The permission system takes hold.
fail_text_en: Followers begin leaving the cult.

label: 충성스러운 측근을 임명한다
success_text_en: A loyal inspector enforces discipline.
fail_text_en: The inspector abuses his power.

label: 감찰은 불필요하다
success_text_en: Without inspection, the cult runs on trust.

label: 허락하고 직접 감수한다
label_en: Allow it and edit it yourself
success_text: 직접 감수한 책이 교리의 기준이 됩니다.
success_text_en: The book you edited becomes the Doctrine's standard.
fail_text_en: Editing takes a long time.

label: 금지한다
success_text_en: The ban keeps the original under control.

label: 측근이 마음대로 편집하게 둔다
label_en: Let your inner circle edit freely
success_text_en: The edited version is well received.
fail_text_en: The edited version contains bizarre interpretations.

label: 책을 비싸게 판다
label_en: Sell the book at a high price
success_text_en: The book sells like hotcakes.
fail_text_en: Criticism pours in over the steep price.

label: 모임을 공식 기구로 인정한다
success_text: 공식 인정에 젊은 신도들이 충성을 맹세합니다.
success_text_en: Officially recognized, the young followers swear loyalty.
fail_text_en: Recognition splits authority.

label: 해산시킨다
success_text_en: Disbanding the group restores order.
fail_text_en: The young people push back against the disbanding.

label: 몰래 감시한다
success_text_en: Surveillance lets you track the group's moves.
fail_text_en: Your surveillance is exposed, and the group grows militant.

label: 모임에 직접 참석해 이끈다
label_en: Join and lead the group yourself
success_text_en: Leading it yourself, you embrace the young.

label: 크게 걸게 한다
success_text_en: The portrait dominates the hall.
fail_text_en: Some call it excessive idolization.

label: 신의 상징 옆에 작게 건다
label_en: Hang it small beside God's symbol
success_text_en: The humble placement wins your followers' favor.

label: 교단 재정에 넣는다
label_en: Put it into the cult's funds
success_text_en: It gives the finances a healthy boost.

label: 신도들에게 공개하고 감사 예배를 연다
label_en: Disclose it and hold a thanksgiving service
success_text_en: Your followers rejoice at the thanksgiving service.
fail_text_en: The disclosure doesn't name the donor, stirring a fuss.

label: 기부자를 찾아 감사를 전한다
label_en: Find the donor and thank them
success_text_en: The donor comes to trust the cult.
fail_text_en: You can't find the donor.

label: 몰래 개인 금고에 넣는다
label_en: Slip it into your personal safe
success_text_en: No one knows about the money in your safe.
fail_text_en: Word of the money gets out, and you lose trust.

label: 절반은 신도들의 잔치에 쓴다
label_en: Spend half on a feast for followers
success_text_en: Your followers gather and laugh at the feast.
fail_text_en: After the feast, money is tight.

label: 헌금으로 수리한다
success_text_en: You fix the roof with offerings.

label: 신도들에게 특별 헌금을 걷는다
success_text_en: The special offering comes in.
fail_text_en: Followers leave over the demand for money.

label: 신도들과 함께 직접 고친다
label_en: Repair it yourself with your followers
success_text_en: Working together deepens your bond.
fail_text_en: A follower is injured during the work.

label: 그냥 둔다
success_text_en: You leave it as it is.

label: 받아들인다
success_text_en: The investment comes in, and the finances can breathe.
fail_text_en: The investment fails and leaves debt behind.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You turn it down cleanly.

label: 조건을 꼼꼼히 따져 본다
success_text_en: Scrutinizing the terms limits your losses.
fail_text_en: The terms are complex, and time slips by.

label: 그의 돈을 받고 약속은 어긴다
label_en: Take his money and break your promise
success_text_en: You take the money and break your word.
fail_text_en: Word gets out that you broke your promise.

label: 도입한다
success_text_en: Seats for offerings swell the finances.
fail_text_en: Critics call it discrimination between rich and poor.

label: 단호히 거부한다
success_text_en: Your refusal earns your followers' respect.

label: 특별석 하나만 만든다
success_text_en: The follower who paid for the special seat is delighted.
fail_text_en: The special seat breeds resentment.

label: 대량으로 만들어 판다
success_text_en: The souvenirs fly off the shelves.
fail_text_en: Unsold stock piles up at a loss.

label: 소량만 정성껏 만든다
label_en: Make a small batch with care
success_text: 정성 어린 기념품이 신도들의 자랑이 됩니다.
success_text_en: The lovingly made souvenirs become your followers' pride.

label: 신도들에게만 나눠 준다
success_text_en: Your followers are delighted.
fail_text_en: Giving them away drains the finances.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You avoid a commercial image.

label: 철저히 조사한다
success_text_en: The investigation uncovers how the money was embezzled.
fail_text_en: The investigation fizzles out, leaving suspicion.

label: 덮고 넘어간다
label_en: Cover it up and move on
success_text_en: The hole you covered is quietly filled.
fail_text_en: The cover-up leaks out.

label: 회계 담당을 교체한다
success_text_en: The new treasurer straightens out the books.

label: 직접 장부를 관리한다
success_text_en: Going over the books yourself, you get a grip on the finances.
fail_text_en: The books are so complex they confuse you.

label: 헌금은 마음이라 위로한다
label_en: Comfort him: offerings come from the heart
success_text_en: Comforted, the follower's eyes well up.
fail_text_en: Your comfort rings hollow.

label: 노동으로 대신하게 한다
success_text_en: He gives labor in place of offerings.

label: 교단이 생활비를 지원한다
label_en: Have the cult support his living costs
success_text_en: The follower is grateful for the support.
fail_text_en: The support strains the finances.

label: 헌금을 독촉한다
success_text_en: Pressing yields a few offerings.
fail_text_en: Word of the pressure spreads, and your Repute falls.

label: 빵집을 연다
success_text: 빵 냄새가 골목을 채우고 동네가 좋아합니다.
success_text_en: The smell of bread fills the alley, and the neighborhood loves it.
fail_text_en: The bread doesn't sell.

label: 찻집을 연다
success_text_en: People gather at the teahouse to talk.
fail_text_en: The teahouse is empty.

label: 신도들의 일자리로 운영한다
success_text_en: Your followers are grateful for the jobs.
fail_text_en: Inexperience leads to losses.

label: 장사는 신앙과 맞지 않는다
success_text_en: You give up the business and focus on faith.

label: 흑자를 신도들과 나눈다
label_en: Share the surplus with your followers
success_text_en: Your followers are moved when you share the surplus.
fail_text_en: After sharing, you fall into the red.

label: 내년을 위해 비축한다
success_text_en: Saving leaves the finances on solid ground.

label: 교단 건물을 늘린다
success_text: 건물이 늘어 신도들을 받을 공간이 생깁니다.
success_text_en: More buildings mean room to take in followers.
fail_text_en: Construction costs shake the finances.

label: 당신의 보수를 올린다
success_text_en: With a raise, life gets comfortable.
fail_text_en: The raise draws your followers' resentment.

label: 구입한다
success_text_en: The relic elevates the cult's majesty.
fail_text_en: The relic turns out to be fake.

label: 모조품을 산다
success_text_en: Replica or not, it serves well enough.

label: 그 돈으로 봉사한다
success_text_en: Service improves the cult's image.
fail_text_en: The service has little effect.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You politely decline.

label: 받는다
success_text_en: You accept the offering and add it to the funds.
fail_text_en: Rumor spreads that it's gambling money.

label: 도박을 끊으라며 거절한다
label_en: Refuse and tell him to quit gambling
success_text_en: Your refusal sets the follower on the right path.
fail_text_en: The follower turns away bitterly.

label: 그 신도에게 도박 비법을 배운다
success_text: 도박 비법으로 돈 버는 법을 익힙니다.
success_text_en: You learn how to make money with his gambling tricks.
fail_text_en: Word gets out that you learned his tricks.

label: 받아서 그에게 다시 돌려준다
label_en: Accept it and give it back to him
success_text_en: The follower is grateful when you return the money.
fail_text_en: Returning it is a hassle.

label: 투명하게 공개한다
success_text_en: Transparent disclosure eases suspicion.
fail_text_en: Flaws come to light during disclosure.

label: 장부를 정리해 일부만 보인다
label_en: Tidy the books and show only part
success_text_en: Showing only part, you dodge an investigation.
fail_text_en: The partial disclosure is exposed, and you are grilled.

label: 종교 단체라며 버틴다
label_en: Hold out as a religious body
success_text_en: You hold out on the grounds of being a religious body.
fail_text_en: Back taxes drain the finances.

label: 측근에게 책임을 미룬다
label_en: Shift the blame to your inner circle
success_text_en: Your confidant shoulders the blame.
fail_text_en: Your confidant walks out.

label: 기쁘게 받는다
success_text_en: The new car raises your Authority.
fail_text_en: Critics call it extravagance.

label: 검소한 차를 고른다
success_text_en: Your followers are moved by the modest car.

label: 그 돈으로 신도용 버스를 산다
label_en: Buy a bus for followers with the money
success_text_en: The followers' bus helps with gatherings.
fail_text_en: Maintaining the bus is a burden.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: Your refusal shows your modesty.

label: 범인을 추적한다
success_text_en: After tracking, you find the culprit.
fail_text_en: The search fizzles out.

label: 신도들의 양심에 호소한다
success_text_en: Your appeal to conscience brings offerings back in.
fail_text_en: No one responds to your appeal.

label: 잃어버린 셈 친다
success_text_en: You write it off and move on.

label: 헌금함에 자물쇠를 단다
label_en: Put a lock on the offering box
success_text_en: The lock protects the finances.

label: 팔아서 자금을 확보한다
success_text_en: Selling the land leaves you flush with funds.
fail_text_en: Land prices fall, and you take a loss.

label: 팔지 않는다
success_text_en: You keep the land.

label: 땅에 기도원을 짓는다
label_en: Build a prayer house on the land
success_text_en: The prayer house draws followers.
fail_text_en: Construction costs balloon.

label: 값을 크게 부풀린다
success_text_en: You sell the land at a steep price.
fail_text_en: Word of the inflated price spreads.

label: 십일조를 도입한다
success_text_en: Tithing stabilizes the finances.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise that the burden has grown.

label: 헌금 대신 봉사 시간을 받는다
label_en: Accept service hours instead of offerings
success_text: 봉사 시간을 받자 신도들이 마음을 엽니다.
success_text_en: Accepting service hours, your followers open their hearts.

label: 성대한 연회를 연다
success_text_en: Patrons flock to the banquet.
fail_text_en: Only the banquet costs soar.

label: 소박한 다과회로 연다
success_text_en: People gather comfortably at the tea party.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: Your refusal shows Temperance.

label: 연회 대신 자선 바자회를 연다
success_text_en: The bazaar leaves a good impression on the community.
fail_text_en: Preparing the bazaar is a hassle.

label: 연회에서 춤판을 벌인다
label_en: Turn the banquet into a dance party
success_text_en: The banquet spills over into a dance party.
fail_text_en: Rumors of the dance party rock the cult.

label: 원인을 조사한다
success_text_en: The investigation finds the cause, and you fix it.
fail_text_en: The cause remains unclear, leaving confusion.

label: 헌금을 강조하는 설교를 한다
success_text_en: After the sermon, offerings rise a little.
fail_text_en: The sermon makes your followers uncomfortable.

label: 당신의 생활비를 줄인다
success_text_en: Cutting your expenses adds to the funds.

label: 기도로 해결을 구한다
success_text_en: Prayer steadies your heart.
fail_text_en: Prayer alone doesn't fix the finances.

label: 크게 환영한다
success_text: 환영 속에 그가 큰 후원을 약속합니다.
success_text_en: Amid the welcome, he pledges major support.
fail_text_en: The lavish welcome looks like favoritism.

label: 다른 신도와 똑같이 대한다
label_en: Treat him like any other follower
success_text_en: Equal treatment earns your followers' respect.

label: 그의 인맥을 활용한다
success_text_en: His connections raise the cult's profile.
fail_text_en: Rumor spreads that you lean on connections.

label: 그의 재산을 노린다
success_text_en: You approach him with your eye on his fortune.
fail_text_en: Your scheme is exposed, and he leaves.

label: 열정적으로 외친다
success_text_en: People stop in their tracks at your passionate cries.
fail_text_en: People turn away from your excessive shouting.

label: 조용히 전단지만 나눈다
success_text: 전단지를 받아 든 사람들이 조금 늘어납니다.
success_text_en: A few more people take your flyers.

label: 노래와 함께 한다
success_text_en: People sing along.
fail_text_en: Noise complaints come in about the singing.

label: 포기한다
success_text_en: You leave the square.

label: 환영 만찬을 준비한다
success_text_en: The guests marvel at the dinner.
fail_text_en: The dinner is poorly prepared, and disappointment runs deep.

label: 평소대로 맞이한다
success_text_en: The ordinary welcome puts them at ease.

label: 친구를 데려온 신도에게 직분을 준다
label_en: Give a post to the follower who brought a friend
success_text_en: The new post spurs the follower on.
fail_text_en: The other followers grow jealous.

label: 의심부터 한다
success_text_en: Your suspicion makes the guest hesitate.
fail_text_en: Hurt by your suspicion, the follower leaves.

label: 철학 토론회를 연다
success_text_en: Students flock to the debate.
fail_text_en: The debate overheats and turns into a commotion.

label: 무료 상담소를 연다
success_text_en: The counseling center listens to the students' worries.
fail_text_en: The running costs weigh on you.

label: 파티를 연다
success_text_en: Students crowd into the party.
fail_text_en: Rumors of the party set the campus buzzing.

label: 포기한다
success_text_en: You leave the campus.

label: 캠퍼스 연극 동아리를 후원한다
success_text_en: Your sponsorship brings you close to the drama club.
fail_text_en: The sponsorship money becomes a burden.

label: 환영회를 연다
success_text_en: At the welcome party, the two groups grow closer.
fail_text_en: The welcome party ends awkwardly.

label: 멘토를 붙여 준다
success_text_en: The mentors guide the followers well.

label: 새 신도만의 모임을 만든다
label_en: Form a group just for new followers
success_text_en: The new followers' group comes alive.
fail_text_en: The rift between the two groups widens.

label: 알아서 적응하라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to adapt on their own
success_text_en: Some followers blend in naturally.
fail_text_en: The new followers drift away.

label: 함께 기도해 준다
success_text_en: Praying together comforts the families.
fail_text_en: The families keep their distance from your prayers.

label: 기적을 약속한다
success_text_en: You promise a miracle, and the families flock to you.
fail_text_en: The promise goes unkept, and resentment pours in.

label: 간병을 도와준다
success_text_en: You help with the caregiving, and the families are grateful.

label: 그냥 돌아온다
success_text_en: You simply go back.

label: 직접 만나 설득한다
label_en: Meet him in person and persuade him
success_text: 직접 만난 설득이 그의 마음을 움직입니다.
success_text_en: Your persuasion in person moves his heart.
fail_text_en: The meeting ends awkwardly.

label: 신도들에게 만남을 맡긴다
label_en: Leave the meeting to your followers
success_text_en: Your followers receive him with care.

label: 그를 이용해 홍보한다
success_text_en: His name spreads word of the cult.
fail_text_en: The publicity goes too far and draws criticism.

label: 무시한다
success_text_en: You ignore it and move on.

label: 영상 설교를 올린다
success_text_en: The video sermon becomes the talk of the town.
fail_text_en: The video becomes a laughingstock.

label: 익명 게시판에 글을 퍼뜨린다
success_text_en: The posts spread, and people come looking.
fail_text_en: The anonymous posts lose credibility.

label: 디지털은 신성하지 않다
success_text_en: You stick to the traditional ways.

label: 신도들이 운영하게 맡긴다
success_text_en: Run by the followers, it comes alive.
fail_text_en: It is run sloppily.

label: 마을 잔치를 열어 준다
success_text_en: The village feast wins the residents' hearts.
fail_text_en: Preparing the feast is overwhelming.

label: 농사일을 도우며 친해진다
label_en: Help with the farmwork and get to know them
success_text_en: You help with the farmwork, and the residents are grateful.

label: 마을 이장을 설득한다
success_text_en: The village head brings the village along.
fail_text_en: The village head refuses, and you turn back.

label: 기적 쇼를 연다
success_text_en: The miracle show sets the village abuzz.
fail_text_en: The show is exposed as a fraud.

label: 받아들인다
success_text_en: Your sermon moves the prisoners' hearts.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: Your refusal shows caution.

label: 출소 후 교단에서 돌보겠다 약속한다
label_en: Promise the cult will care for them after release
success_text_en: The promise gives the prisoners hope.
fail_text_en: There is deep worry the promise won't be kept.

label: 그들의 힘을 교단에 쓴다
label_en: Put their strength to work for the cult
success_text_en: The cult puts the prisoners' strength to use.
fail_text_en: Your ties to the prisoners leak out.

label: 부풀린다
success_text: 부풀린 숫자가 교단을 커 보이게 합니다.
success_text_en: The inflated numbers make the cult look bigger.
fail_text_en: The lie is exposed, and you lose trust.

label: 정직하게 발표한다
success_text_en: The honest announcement earns trust.

label: 아예 발표하지 않는다
success_text_en: You hide the numbers.
fail_text_en: You are suspected of hiding something.

label: 통역을 구해 맞이한다
label_en: Find an interpreter and welcome them
success_text_en: Thanks to the interpreter, you understand each other.
fail_text_en: The interpreter is clumsy, and misunderstandings arise.

label: 그들의 언어로 경전을 번역한다
label_en: Translate the scripture into their language
success_text_en: The translation wins their hearts.
fail_text_en: The translation goes wrong, and confusion follows.

label: 거리를 둔다
success_text_en: You keep your distance.

label: 일자리를 소개해 준다
success_text_en: They are grateful for the job referrals.
fail_text_en: The referrals don't pan out as hoped.

label: 두 팔 벌려 환영한다
success_text_en: The welcome brings the follower to tears.
fail_text_en: The welcome feels too light.

label: 참회 의식을 거치게 한다
label_en: Make them undergo a rite of repentance
success_text_en: Having returned through repentance, the follower stands firm.
fail_text_en: The rite is harsh, and they leave again.

label: 받아 주지 않는다
success_text_en: By refusing them, you keep order.

label: 모두 받아들인다
success_text_en: Followers pour in all at once.
fail_text_en: A clash with the rival cult breaks out.

label: 엄격한 심사를 한다
success_text_en: The followers who pass the screening stand firm.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise that the screening is too strict.

label: 돌려보낸다
success_text_en: You politely send them back.

label: 경쟁 교단의 비밀을 캐낸다
label_en: Dig up the rival cult's secrets
success_text_en: You unearth secrets and use them to persuade the followers.
fail_text_en: Your snooping is found out.

label: 점괘를 봐 준다
success_text_en: People laugh and chatter over the fortunes.
fail_text_en: Word gets around that the fortunes are wrong.

label: 무료 음식을 나눈다
success_text_en: You share food, and people are grateful.

label: 교단 음악을 공연한다
success_text_en: People sing along to the music.

label: 경품 추첨을 한다
success_text_en: People crowd around the raffle.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise that the prizes are shoddy.

label: 가족 세례식을 연다
success_text_en: The family is moved by the baptism.

label: 조용히 받아들인다
success_text_en: You accept it quietly.

label: 옛이야기를 들어 드린다
success_text_en: The elderly delight in sharing their old stories.

label: 건강 체조를 함께 한다
success_text_en: The exercises put new life into the elderly.
fail_text_en: Word gets around that the exercises were too much.

label: 장례 의식을 약속한다
success_text_en: The promise of funeral rites puts the elderly at ease.
fail_text_en: Some say the promise is a heavy burden.

label: 효과가 없다며 그만둔다
success_text_en: They quit and look elsewhere.

label: 맞서 논쟁한다
success_text_en: You win the argument, and the onlookers applaud.
fail_text_en: The argument turns into a fight.

label: 조용히 자리를 피한다
success_text_en: You quietly slip away.

label: 상대를 위해 기도한다
success_text_en: The sight of you praying moves the onlookers.
fail_text_en: Your prayer comes across as sarcasm.

label: 신도들을 불러 세를 과시한다
label_en: Call in followers to show your strength
success_text_en: Faced with your followers' momentum, your opponent backs down.
fail_text_en: The show of force spreads as rumors of violence.

label: 매주 발행한다
success_text: 매주 소식지를 받아 보는 사람이 늘어납니다.
success_text_en: More and more people subscribe to the weekly newsletter.
fail_text_en: The printing costs weigh on you.

label: 계절마다 발행한다
success_text_en: The seasonal newsletter finds steady readers.

label: 유료로 판다
success_text_en: The newsletter makes money.
fail_text_en: Because it costs money, readership drops.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline.

label: 적극 지원한다
success_text_en: Word of the tutoring spreads through the neighborhood, and people come.
fail_text_en: The funding is tight.

label: 부모들에게도 포교한다
success_text_en: The parents come to the cult.
fail_text_en: The parents grow wary of the proselytizing.

label: 교단 이름은 숨긴다
success_text_en: With the name hidden, the parents feel at ease.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline.

label: 살생하지 말라
success_text: 살생하지 말라는 계율이 신도들의 마음을 얻습니다.
success_text_en: The commandment against killing wins the followers' hearts.

label: 교주에게 복종하라
success_text_en: The commandment of obedience brings order to the cult.
fail_text_en: Backlash arises that obedience is being forced.

label: 욕망을 부정하지 말라
success_text: 욕망을 인정하는 계율이 신도들을 편하게 합니다.
success_text_en: A commandment that accepts desire puts the followers at ease.
fail_text_en: Some point out that the commandment is vague.

label: 진실만을 말하라
success_text_en: The commandment of truth builds trust.

label: 매주 하루 금식
success_text_en: The weekly fast becomes the backbone of the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise that the fasting is hard.

label: 한 달에 한 번
success_text: 한 달에 한 번의 금식이 무난하게 자리 잡습니다.
success_text_en: The monthly fast settles in smoothly.

label: 금식 대신 잔치의 날을 만든다
label_en: Make a feast day instead of a fast
success_text_en: The feast day brings the followers joy.
fail_text_en: Some say the Doctrine is too lax.

label: 넣지 않는다
success_text_en: You leave out the fasting clause.

label: 모순을 인정하고 고친다
label_en: Admit the contradiction and fix it
success_text_en: Fixing the contradiction makes the Doctrine all the more solid.
fail_text_en: The revisions cause confusion.

label: 더 깊은 해석으로 설명한다
label_en: Explain it with a deeper interpretation
success_text_en: The deeper interpretation convinces the followers.
fail_text_en: The explanation sounds forced.

label: 질문한 신도를 칭찬한다
success_text_en: The praise moves the follower.

label: 의심하지 말라 꾸짖는다
success_text_en: Your scolding makes the questions vanish.
fail_text_en: Word of the scolding gets around.

label: 천국과 지옥
success_text_en: The doctrine of heaven and hell is clear to the followers.

label: 윤회
success_text_en: The doctrine of reincarnation lends an air of mystery.
fail_text_en: Some say reincarnation feels foreign.

label: 사후 세계는 없다
success_text_en: The Doctrine becomes focused on this life.
fail_text_en: Your followers feel something is missing.

label: 교주를 따른 자만 구원받는다
label_en: Only those who follow the cult leader are saved
success_text_en: The condition for salvation becomes the cult's strength.
fail_text_en: It is criticized as exclusionary.

label: 각자의 믿음대로 열린다
label_en: It opens according to each one's faith
success_text_en: The open Doctrine welcomes many people.

label: 엄격히 금한다
success_text_en: The strict taboo establishes order.
fail_text_en: Some say the taboo is cruel.

label: 결혼 안에서만 허락한다
success_text_en: Allowing it within marriage goes over fine.

label: 신성한 의식으로 삼는다
success_text_en: The rite gives the followers a mystical meaning.
fail_text_en: The rite spreads outside as a scandal.

label: 자유에 맡긴다
success_text_en: The freedom puts the followers at ease.

label: 교주만이 축복할 수 있다
label_en: Only the cult leader may bless it
success_text_en: The power to bless gathers in the cult leader.
fail_text_en: A flood of criticism calls it a doctrine of privilege.

label: 가난이 곧 거룩함이다
success_text_en: The doctrine of poverty comforts the followers.
fail_text_en: Critics say poverty is being forced on people.

label: 재물은 신의 축복이다
label_en: Wealth is a blessing from god
success_text_en: The doctrine of blessing draws Offerings.
fail_text_en: It is criticized as materialism.

label: 가진 것을 나눠라
success_text_en: The doctrine of sharing binds the followers together.

label: 모든 재물은 교단에 바쳐라
label_en: Give all wealth to the cult
success_text_en: Wealth flows into the cult.
fail_text_en: The followers feel their property was taken.

label: 재물은 놀이일 뿐이다
success_text: 재물을 가볍게 보는 교리가 신도들에게 편안합니다.
success_text_en: A doctrine that takes wealth lightly puts the followers at ease.

label: 직접 다듬어 출간한다
label_en: Polish it yourself and publish it
success_text_en: The published scripture becomes the face of the cult.
fail_text_en: The publishing costs weigh on you.

label: 비밀 경전으로 둔다
success_text_en: The secret scripture adds an air of mystery.
fail_text_en: The secrecy invites suspicion.

label: 적극 차용한다
success_text_en: The borrowed doctrines bring in more followers.
fail_text_en: The borrowing is denounced as plagiarism.

label: 차용하되 출처를 밝힌다
success_text_en: Citing the sources earns respect.

label: 독창성을 지킨다
success_text_en: Originality gives the Doctrine its character.
fail_text_en: Its strong character also turns some away.

label: 교묘하게 바꿔 우리 것으로 만든다
label_en: Cleverly rework it into your own
success_text: 바꾼 교리가 우리 것처럼 자리 잡습니다.
success_text_en: The reworked doctrine settles in as if it were yours.
fail_text_en: The original author protests, and a commotion follows.

label: 하루 다섯 번
success_text_en: Praying five times a day steadies their faith.
fail_text_en: So many prayers are a strain.

label: 아침과 저녁
success_text_en: Morning and evening prayers go over fine.

label: 원할 때 언제든
success_text_en: Free-form prayer puts the followers at ease.

label: 교주의 명이 있을 때
success_text: 교주의 명에 따른 기도가 권위를 세웁니다.
success_text_en: Prayer at the cult leader's command builds Authority.
fail_text_en: Prayer on command breeds discontent.

label: 직접 가르친다
success_text_en: Your personal teaching moves the followers.
fail_text_en: The lectures run long and wear you out.

label: 제자들에게 맡긴다
success_text_en: Your disciples lead the meetings.
fail_text_en: Each disciple teaches something different.

label: 교리는 외우기만 하면 된다
label_en: Doctrine only needs to be memorized
success_text_en: Rote study establishes order.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise that it's boring.

label: 토론식으로 운영한다
success_text_en: Discussion deepens the followers' understanding.
fail_text_en: The discussion overheats.

label: 가까운 종말을 예언한다
label_en: Prophesy an imminent end of the world
success_text_en: The doomsday prophecy puts the followers on edge and draws them close.
fail_text_en: The prophecy misses, and you lose trust.

label: 먼 미래의 일로 둔다
label_en: Leave it to the distant future
success_text_en: You leave it to the distant future.

label: 종말은 없다
label_en: There is no end of the world
success_text_en: A Doctrine without an apocalypse brings reassurance.
fail_text_en: The followers feel let down.

label: 종말 날짜를 정한다
label_en: Set a date for the end
success_text_en: The date sets the followers ablaze.
fail_text_en: The date passes, and followers leave.

label: 고기를 금한다
success_text_en: The meat taboo teaches Temperance.
fail_text_en: Malnutrition sets in.

label: 술을 금한다
success_text_en: The alcohol taboo protects your Repute.

label: 금기는 없다
success_text_en: A Doctrine without taboos is easygoing.

label: 교주가 축복한 음식만 먹는다
label_en: Eat only food blessed by the cult leader
success_text_en: Blessed food builds Authority.
fail_text_en: It is condemned as controlling what people eat.

label: 교주 앞에서만 마음껏 먹는다
label_en: Eat freely only in the cult leader's presence
success_text: 교주 앞의 식사가 신도들의 복종을 키웁니다.
success_text_en: Dining before the cult leader deepens the followers' obedience.
fail_text_en: Rumors of the meals spread.

label: 뱀
success_text_en: The serpent symbol lends an air of mystery.
fail_text_en: Some say the serpent is ominous.

label: 양
success_text_en: The lamb symbol conveys gentleness.

label: 까마귀
success_text_en: The raven symbol conveys wisdom.

label: 사자
success_text_en: The lion symbol conveys majesty.

label: 한쪽 손을 들어 준다
success_text_en: Siding with one settles the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The side you didn't back leaves.

label: 두 해석을 모두 인정한다
success_text_en: Accepting both interpretations brings reconciliation.

label: 새로운 제3의 해석을 내놓는다
success_text_en: The third interpretation unites both factions.
fail_text_en: Some say the third interpretation is hard to follow.

label: 양쪽 모두 입을 다물게 한다
success_text_en: Silencing them quiets the strife.
fail_text_en: Some call it oppression.

label: 엄격한 고행을 넣는다
success_text_en: The ascetic practices build the followers' Patience.
fail_text_en: Some followers collapse from the austerities.

label: 가벼운 절제로 대신한다
success_text_en: Light self-restraint goes over fine.

label: 고행은 필요 없다
success_text_en: A Doctrine without austerities is easygoing.

label: 교주만 고행한다
label_en: Only the cult leader practices austerity
success_text_en: Your austerity earns respect.
fail_text_en: Talk goes around that only the cult leader suffers.

label: 교단 창설일
success_text_en: Founding day becomes the cult's pride.

label: 교주의 탄생일
success_text_en: The birthday upholds the cult leader's majesty.
fail_text: 자기 생일을 명절로 삼는다는 비판이 나옵니다.
fail_text_en: Critics say you made your own birthday a holiday.

label: 첫 계시의 날
label_en: The day of the first Revelation
success_text_en: The day of the first Revelation lends an air of mystery.

label: 추수 감사의 날
success_text: 추수 감사의 날이 신도들을 기쁘게 합니다.
success_text_en: Harvest thanksgiving day delights the followers.

label: 동화로 만든다
success_text_en: The fairy tale wins the children's hearts.

label: 그림책으로 만든다
success_text_en: The picture book spreads from house to house.
fail_text_en: The picture book's printing costs weigh on you.

label: 교리는 쉬워서는 안 된다
success_text_en: A difficult Doctrine raises your Authority.
fail_text_en: The children drift away.

label: 노래로 만든다
success_text_en: In song, the Doctrine spreads easily.

label: 참회하면 모두 용서받는다
success_text_en: The doctrine of repentance comforts the followers.

label: 죄에 따라 헌금으로 속죄한다
label_en: Atone with Offerings according to the sin
success_text_en: Atonement Offerings swell the coffers.
fail_text_en: It is condemned as haggling over the price of sin.

label: 엄격한 처벌을 정한다
success_text_en: The punishment clauses establish order.
fail_text_en: Some say the punishments are cruel.

label: 교주가 직접 심판한다
success_text_en: Your judgment raises your Authority.
fail_text_en: Some say the judgments are unfair.

label: 과감히 수정한다
success_text: 과감한 수정이 시대에 맞춰 교리를 살립니다.
success_text_en: Bold revision brings the Doctrine in step with the times.
fail_text_en: The revision breeds confusion.

label: 원형을 지킨다
success_text_en: Conviction in the original steadies the followers.
fail_text_en: It is criticized as anachronistic.

label: 수정하되 새 계시라 포장한다
label_en: Revise it, but package it as a new Revelation
success_text_en: The new Revelation preserves the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The fabricated Revelation is exposed.

label: 신도들의 투표로 정한다
success_text: 투표로 정한 교리가 신도들의 자부심이 됩니다.
success_text_en: A Doctrine decided by vote becomes the followers' pride.

label: 귀를 기울인다
success_text_en: You strain your ears toward the whisper.
fail_text_en: The whisper grows louder and louder.

label: 속삭임을 받아 적는다
success_text_en: The words you transcribe find their way into the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: What you wrote down is a jumble.

label: 기도를 멈춘다
success_text_en: You stop praying and catch your breath.

label: 측근을 불러 확인한다
label_en: Call your inner circle to check
success_text_en: Your inner circle says they heard nothing.
fail_text_en: Your inner circle looks at you strangely.

label: 제단에 제물을 바친다
label_en: Make an offering at the altar
success_text_en: As you make the offering, the altar grows warm.
fail_text_en: The offering vanishes into thin air.

label: 제단을 봉인한다
success_text_en: You seal the altar to keep everyone safe.

label: 신도들에게 공개한다
success_text_en: The followers feel awe before the revealed altar.
fail_text_en: Rumors spread that the altar is sinister.

label: 제단에서 밤새 명상한다
label_en: Meditate at the altar all night
success_text_en: The all-night meditation leads to deep Communion.
fail_text_en: After meditating, your mind is foggy.

label: 더 깊이 빠져든다
success_text: 더 깊은 명상에서 신비로운 기운을 얻습니다.
success_text_en: In deeper meditation, you draw a mystical energy.
fail_text_en: Lost in meditation, your body suffers.

label: 두려워 멈춘다
success_text_en: You overcome your fear and stop.

label: 신도들 앞에서 재현해 본다
success_text_en: The reenacted meditation enraptures the followers.
fail_text_en: The reenactment fails, and talk of fraud goes around.

label: 기록으로 남긴다
success_text_en: The record becomes a basis for the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The record is too hazy to be of use.

label: 신의 증표라 받아들인다
label_en: Accept it as a sign from god
success_text_en: Hearing it called a sign, the followers grow fervent.
fail_text_en: Some say the testimony is exaggerated.

label: 빛의 의미를 설교한다
label_en: Preach on the meaning of the light
success_text_en: The sermon deepens the followers' understanding.
fail_text_en: The sermon is vague.

label: 그를 조용히 돌려보낸다
success_text_en: You quietly send him back.

label: 배운다
success_text_en: You learn the secret arts and gain a mystical power.
fail_text_en: Getting mixed up with a shaman hurts your Repute.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: You politely decline.

label: 비법만 듣고 쫓아낸다
label_en: Hear the secret arts, then throw her out
success_text_en: You take the secret arts and send the shaman away.
fail_text_en: The shaman spreads rumors.

label: 무당을 교단에 영입한다
label_en: Recruit the shaman into the cult
success_text_en: The shaman becomes the cult's new face.
fail_text_en: Critics say the cult leans on shamanism.

label: 신의 메시지라 여긴다
label_en: Take it as a message from god
success_text_en: Taking it as a message stirs the followers.
fail_text_en: Backlash arises calling it superstition.

label: 바람 탓이라 여긴다
success_text_en: You calmly let it pass.

label: 다시 켜고 기도를 이어 간다
success_text_en: The prayer continues.

label: 불길한 징조라 경고한다
label_en: Warn that it is an ill omen
success_text_en: Your warning of an omen puts the followers on edge.
fail_text_en: Some say the warning breeds fear.

label: 북소리에 맞춰 춤춘다
success_text_en: The drumbeat enraptures the followers.
fail_text_en: The dancing goes too far, and someone collapses.

label: 침묵 속에서 명상한다
success_text_en: The silence brings deep meditation.

label: 약초 향을 피운다
success_text_en: The heavy incense makes everyone hazy.
fail_text_en: The incense is so thick it makes people cough.

label: 의식을 취소한다
success_text_en: You cancel the ritual.

label: 신도들과 밤새 연회를 벌인다
label_en: Feast all night with the followers
success_text_en: The feast goes on all night.
fail_text_en: The feast spreads as a scandal.

label: 예언으로 기록한다
success_text_en: The recorded prophecy becomes Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The prophecy doesn't come true, and you become a laughingstock.

label: 신도들에게 해석을 맡긴다
success_text_en: Each follower interprets it differently.
fail_text_en: The conflicting interpretations cause confusion.

label: 못 들은 척한다
success_text_en: You pretend you didn't hear.

label: 예언이 맞도록 몰래 일을 꾸민다
label_en: Secretly rig events so the prophecy comes true
success_text_en: Events unfold as though the prophecy were coming true.
fail_text_en: Your scheme is exposed, and you lose trust.

label: 밤새 기도한다
success_text_en: The all-night prayer brings deep Communion.
fail_text_en: The cold takes a toll on your body.

label: 두려워 나온다
success_text_en: Unable to overcome your fear, you come out.

label: 신과 자연의 뜻이라 여긴다
label_en: Take it as the will of god and nature
success_text_en: Calling it nature's will moves the followers.

label: 동물들을 돌본다
success_text: 동물을 돌보는 모습이 좋은 인상을 줍니다.
success_text_en: The sight of you caring for the animals makes a good impression.
fail_text_en: The feed costs money.

label: 사진을 찍어 홍보한다
success_text_en: The photos run in the newspaper.
fail_text_en: Rumors spread that the photos were doctored.

label: 우연이라 생각한다
success_text_en: You shrug it off as coincidence.

label: 당신의 이름을 답한다
success_text_en: As you answer with your name, the serpent vanishes.
fail_text_en: The dream continues, ominous.

label: 교단의 이름을 답한다
success_text_en: The cult's name becomes the dream's Revelation.
fail_text_en: The dream fades into a blur.

label: 뱀의 이름을 되묻는다
success_text_en: The serpent whispers an unfamiliar name.
fail_text_en: The serpent's answer fills you with dread.

label: 깨어난다
success_text_en: You wake from the dream.

label: 성물 앞에서 기도한다
success_text_en: At the end of your prayer, the trembling subsides.
fail_text_en: The trembling won't stop.

label: 신도들에게 보여 준다
success_text_en: The followers stand in awe of the trembling.
fail_text_en: Some say the trembling is a trick.

label: 조사해 본다
success_text_en: Your investigation finds the cause.

label: 성물을 숨긴다
success_text_en: You hide the relic to prevent an uproar.
fail_text_en: Word gets out that you hid it.

label: 기적이라 선포한다
success_text_en: Rumors of the miracle spread, and followers multiply.
fail_text_en: The medical records are made public, and the miracle is called into question.

label: 의사의 공이라 말한다
success_text_en: Your honesty earns trust.

label: 조용히 감사 기도를 드린다
label_en: Quietly offer a prayer of thanks
success_text_en: The prayer of thanks wins the followers' hearts.

label: 대가를 치른다
success_text_en: Once you pay the price, the voice falls quiet.
fail_text_en: The price is too steep, and your finances totter.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You refuse and keep up the ritual.

label: 협상한다
success_text_en: Through negotiation, you lower the price.
fail_text_en: The negotiation breaks down, leaving you uneasy.

label: 의식을 끊는다
success_text_en: You break off the ritual and pull yourself out.

label: 성수로 지정한다
success_text_en: The holy water becomes the followers' pride.
fail_text_en: Word gets around that the well water is contaminated.

label: 성수를 판다
success_text_en: The holy water sells well.
fail_text_en: The holy water trade draws criticism.

label: 우물을 막는다
success_text_en: You seal the well for safety.

label: 우물가에서 명상한다
success_text_en: Your meditation by the well deepens.
fail_text_en: You catch a cold in the night air.

label: 인정하고 예언자로 세운다
label_en: Acknowledge him and make him a prophet
success_text_en: The prophet leads the followers.
fail_text_en: The prophet grows arrogant, and strife follows.

label: 거짓이라 몰아세운다
success_text_en: Denouncing him restores order.
fail_text_en: Some say the denunciation was harsh.

label: 체험 내용을 함께 검증한다
success_text_en: The verification process earns trust.

label: 그의 체험을 당신 것으로 만든다
label_en: Claim his experience as your own
success_text_en: His experience is passed on as yours.
fail_text_en: The plagiarism is exposed, and you lose trust.

label: 대규모 의식을 연다
success_text_en: Followers gather for the grand ritual.
fail_text_en: The ritual costs too much.

label: 홀로 산에 올라 기도한다
label_en: Climb the mountain alone and pray
success_text_en: You pray atop the mountain.
fail_text_en: The climb is grueling.

label: 과학 현상이라 설명한다
label_en: Explain it as a scientific phenomenon
success_text_en: Explaining it with science earns trust.
fail_text_en: The sense of mystery fades.

label: 영혼들과 대화를 시도한다
label_en: Try to speak with the spirits
success_text_en: Speaking with the spirits brings a mystical Revelation.
fail_text_en: The conversation is frightening, and rumors spread.

label: 서둘러 떠난다
success_text_en: You leave in a hurry.

label: 적극 협조한다
success_text_en: Your full cooperation earns a favorable article.
fail_text_en: The cooperation goes awry, and the article comes out ambiguous.

label: 조건을 걸고 허락한다
success_text_en: Conditional access preserves trust.
fail_text_en: Some say the conditions are too strict.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: Your refusal shows caution.

label: 기자를 매수한다
success_text_en: The bought article puts the cult in a glowing light.
fail_text: 매수가 드러나 신문 전체가 등을 돌립니다.
fail_text_en: The bribe is exposed, and the whole paper turns on you.

label: 신도들을 인터뷰하게 한다
success_text_en: The followers' candid interviews win sympathy.
fail_text_en: The interviews are a mess, and you become a laughingstock.

label: 공식 해명문을 낸다
success_text_en: The official statement quiets the rumors.
fail_text_en: The statement reads like an excuse.

label: 무시한다
success_text_en: You ignore them, and the rumors die down.
fail_text_en: Ignoring them only feeds the rumors.

label: 봉사 활동으로 이미지를 바꾼다
label_en: Change your image through volunteer work
success_text_en: The volunteer work changes the cult's image.
fail_text_en: The volunteer work is slow to pay off.

label: 루머를 퍼뜨린 자를 찾아낸다
label_en: Track down whoever spread the rumors
success_text_en: You find the ringleader and make an example of them.
fail_text_en: The hunt goes too far and draws criticism.

label: 대대적으로 돕는다
success_text_en: Your large-scale relief effort becomes known nationwide.
fail_text_en: Critics complain the relief supplies fall short.

label: 조용히 돕는다
success_text_en: Your quiet relief earns the victims' gratitude.

label: 홍보용 사진만 찍는다
success_text_en: The photos run in the newspaper.
fail_text_en: A flood of criticism calls it hypocrisy.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: Your refusal is called cold.

label: 집회 시간을 줄인다
success_text_en: With shorter gatherings, the residents are relieved.

label: 방음 공사를 한다
success_text_en: Soundproofing solves the noise problem.
fail_text_en: The construction costs weigh on you.

label: 주민들을 초대해 대접한다
label_en: Invite the residents and treat them
success_text_en: Your hospitality softens the residents.
fail_text_en: Hospitality alone doesn't dispel the complaints.

label: 무시한다
success_text_en: The followers are satisfied, but the residents turn against you.
fail_text_en: The complaint runs in the newspaper.

label: 공개 지지한다
success_text: 공개 지지로 교단의 정치적 영향력이 커집니다.
success_text_en: The public endorsement grows the cult's political influence.
fail_text_en: It is condemned as political meddling.

label: 중립을 지킨다
success_text_en: Your neutrality earns trust.

label: 뒤에서 거래한다
success_text_en: The backroom deal benefits the cult.
fail_text_en: The deal is exposed, and a commotion follows.

label: 후보를 신도로 만든다
success_text: 후보가 신도가 되어 교단의 얼굴이 됩니다.
success_text_en: The candidate becomes a follower and the face of the cult.
fail_text: 신도가 된 후보를 두고 말이 많습니다.
fail_text_en: There is much talk about the candidate turned follower.

label: 후보에게 교단의 요구를 내건다
label_en: Put the cult's demands to the candidate
success_text_en: Your demands are met, and the cult profits.
fail_text_en: The demands go public and become a political scandal.

label: 공개 사과한다
success_text_en: A heartfelt apology softens public opinion.
fail_text_en: Critics say the apology came too late.

label: 그 신도를 파문한다
success_text_en: With the excommunication, the cult draws a line.
fail_text_en: The excommunication shakes the followers.

label: 무관하다고 선을 긋는다
success_text_en: Your disavowal provokes backlash.
fail_text_en: Your claim of no connection is exposed as a lie.

label: 그를 변호한다
success_text_en: Your defense moves the followers.

label: 연다
success_text_en: The soup kitchen earns the neighborhood's trust.
fail_text_en: The kitchen's costs weigh on you.

label: 주말에만 연다
success_text_en: The weekend meals carry on smoothly.

label: 급식소에서 포교도 한다
label_en: Proselytize at the soup kitchen too
success_text_en: The soup kitchen brings in more followers.
fail_text_en: The proselytizing motive is exposed and draws criticism.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline.

label: 반박 책을 낸다
success_text_en: The rebuttal book lays out the Doctrine's logic.
fail_text_en: Reviewers call the rebuttal feeble.

label: 저자를 만나 대화한다
success_text_en: The conversation deepens your mutual understanding.
fail_text_en: The talk goes nowhere.

label: 소송을 건다
success_text_en: The lawsuit protects the cult's standing.
fail_text_en: You lose the lawsuit, and your finances totter.

label: 신도들에게 읽지 말라 한다
label_en: Tell the followers not to read it
success_text_en: The followers keep away from the book.
fail_text: 금서라는 말에 오히려 책이 더 팔립니다.
fail_text_en: Calling it forbidden only makes the book sell more.

label: 크게 후원한다
success_text_en: Your generous sponsorship puts the cult's name on the festival.
fail_text_en: The return is small for what you spent.

label: 소소하게 후원한다
success_text_en: The modest sponsorship goes over fine.

label: 축제에서 교단을 홍보한다
label_en: Promote the cult at the festival
success_text_en: The festival spreads word of the cult.
fail_text_en: Some say the promotion sticks out.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline.

label: 진심으로 반성한다
success_text_en: Your show of remorse softens public opinion.
fail_text_en: Some say the remorse is just for show.

label: 공개 반박한다
success_text_en: The rebuttal gets the cult's voice heard.
fail_text_en: The rebuttal looks like picking a fight.

label: 그를 위해 기도한다고 발표한다
label_en: Announce that you will pray for him
success_text: 기도 발표가 교단의 여유를 보여 줍니다.
success_text_en: The prayer announcement shows the cult's composure.
fail_text_en: The prayer announcement becomes a joke.

label: 그의 과거를 폭로한다
success_text_en: The exposé draws attention.
fail_text_en: The exposé backfires.

label: 인터뷰에 응해 해명한다
success_text_en: The explanatory interview softens the viewers.
fail_text_en: Your explanation is edited and distorted.

label: 촬영을 막는다
success_text_en: Blocking the filming deepens the suspicion.
fail_text_en: The footage of you blocking them airs, making it worse.

label: 신도들의 평범한 일상을 보여 준다
success_text_en: Ordinary daily life breaks down prejudice.

label: 잠적한다
success_text_en: Your disappearance shakes the cult.
fail_text_en: Going into hiding looks like an admission of guilt.

label: 방송을 거꾸로 포교에 이용한다
success_text_en: The broadcast becomes a stage to promote the cult.
fail_text_en: The broadcast paints the cult as a pack of frauds.

label: 교단 조끼를 입고 참여한다
success_text_en: The cult vests become a symbol of service.

label: 당신이 직접 앞장선다
success_text_en: Leading from the front earns praise.
fail_text_en: You push too hard and hurt yourself.

label: 참석해 교단을 소개한다
success_text: 소개가 여러 종교 지도자에게 인상을 남깁니다.
success_text_en: Your introduction leaves an impression on many religious leaders.
fail_text_en: Your introduction comes across as boasting.

label: 참석해 듣기만 한다
success_text_en: By listening, you learn.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline.

label: 모임을 주도하려 한다
success_text_en: You become the center of the meeting.
fail_text_en: A power struggle breaks out.

label: 기부금을 투명하게 공개한다
success_text_en: Transparent disclosure raises trust.
fail_text_en: Some say the disclosure is a hassle.

label: 일부를 교단 운영비로 쓴다
label_en: Use some for the cult's operating costs
success_text_en: The operating funds give your finances breathing room.
fail_text_en: The diversion of funds is found out.

label: 쉼터를 확장한다
success_text_en: The expanded shelter helps many more people.

label: 기부자 명단을 홍보에 쓴다
label_en: Use the donor list for publicity
success_text_en: Publicizing the list makes the cult famous.
fail_text_en: The list is criticized as an invasion of privacy.

label: 학교를 찾아가 대화한다
success_text_en: Talking it out reduces the bullying.
fail_text_en: The school isn't cooperative.

label: 학생에게 신앙을 숨기라 한다
label_en: Tell the student to hide their faith
success_text_en: Hiding their faith wounds the student.

label: 강경하게 항의한다
success_text_en: The protest emboldens the followers.
fail_text_en: The protest deepens the conflict with the school.

label: 교단 학교를 세우겠다고 한다
label_en: Announce you will found a cult school
success_text_en: The plan for a cult school draws followers.
fail_text_en: Some say founding a school is too much of a burden.

label: 적극 협조한다
success_text: 연구 협조가 교리를 학술적으로 빛나게 합니다.
success_text_en: Cooperating with the research lends the Doctrine scholarly luster.
fail_text_en: As the materials are made public, weaknesses come to light.

label: 조건부로 허락한다
success_text_en: Conditional permission earns trust.
fail_text_en: The conditions are so strict the research stalls.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline.

label: 학자를 신도로 만든다
success_text: 학자가 신도가 되어 교단의 권위를 높입니다.
success_text_en: The scholar becomes a follower and raises the cult's Authority.
fail_text_en: The scholar leaves and criticizes the cult.

label: 교단 장학금을 만든다
success_text_en: The scholarship gives the students hope.
fail_text_en: There isn't enough money for the scholarship.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline.

label: 기꺼이 손을 잡는다
success_text_en: The reconciliation raises the cult's Repute.
fail_text_en: The reconciliation ends as a formality.

label: 경계하며 받아들인다
success_text_en: A wary reconciliation goes over fine.
fail_text_en: Your wariness shows, and things grow awkward.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: You decline.

label: 그 교회 신도들을 노린다
success_text: 그 교회 신도들이 교단으로 옮겨 옵니다.
success_text_en: That church's members move over to your cult.
fail_text_en: Your scheme is exposed, and you are isolated among religious groups.

label: 조촐한 축하 예배를 연다
success_text_en: The followers rejoice at the celebration service.

label: 더 큰 목표를 선포한다
success_text_en: The bigger goal fires up the followers.
fail_text_en: Some say the goal is a pipe dream.

label: 더 넓은 곳을 빌린다
success_text_en: The bigger meeting hall holds more followers.
fail_text_en: The rent weighs on you.

label: 두 번에 나눠 모인다
success_text: 두 번에 나눠 모여 불편이 줄어듭니다.
success_text_en: Meeting in two sessions eases the crowding.

label: 소모임 체제로 바꾼다
success_text_en: The small groups strengthen the followers' bonds.
fail_text_en: The small groups go their own way, and control slips.

label: 기자 회견을 연다
success_text_en: The press conference introduces the cult to the world.
fail_text_en: What you said at the press conference is distorted.

label: 조용히 내실을 다진다
success_text_en: As you build from within, the followers settle down.

label: 교단 본부를 세운다
success_text_en: The headquarters upholds the cult's majesty.
fail_text_en: The headquarters costs a fortune to build.

label: 경계를 강화한다
success_text_en: Security establishes order.
fail_text_en: The security breeds hostility outside.

label: 지부를 세운다
success_text_en: The branches expand the cult.
fail_text_en: The branches cost a lot to run.

label: 본부 중심 체제를 유지한다
success_text_en: Centering on headquarters keeps order.

label: 측근들에게 지부를 나눠 준다
label_en: Hand out branches to your inner circle
success_text_en: Your inner circle takes charge of the branches, and the cult expands.
fail_text_en: The branch heads build up their own power.

label: 간증 집회를 연다
success_text_en: Followers flock to the testimony gathering.

label: 간증을 책으로 엮는다
label_en: Compile the testimonies into a book
success_text_en: The book of testimonies puts flesh on the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The testimonies are exaggerated, and the book draws criticism.

label: 간증을 헌금으로 연결한다
success_text_en: The testimonies turn into Offerings.
fail_text_en: Linking them to Offerings draws criticism.

label: 맹세를 받아들인다
success_text_en: The vow becomes the cult's strength.
fail_text_en: The excessive vow raises concern outside.

label: 그 맹세를 신에게 돌린다
success_text_en: The vow is sublimated into faith.

label: 맹세를 거두라 한다
label_en: Tell them to withdraw the vow
success_text_en: Once the vow is withdrawn, trust is restored.

label: 맹세를 시험해 본다
success_text_en: The test reveals how deep the vow runs.
fail_text_en: Rumors spread that the test was cruel.

label: 맹세를 계약서로 남긴다
label_en: Put the vow in a written contract
success_text_en: The contract binds the followers.
fail_text_en: The contract becomes a problem and sends out ripples.

label: 믿음을 절제하라 설교한다
success_text_en: The sermon on moderation softens the public view.

label: 더욱 불을 지핀다
success_text_en: The followers' fervor burns hotter.
fail_text_en: The fervor looks like a threat from outside.

label: 외부와의 접촉을 끊는다
label_en: Cut off contact with the outside
success_text_en: Isolated, the cult grows more tightly bound.
fail_text_en: The isolation feeds suspicion.

label: 광신을 교단의 힘으로 쓴다
label_en: Harness the fanaticism as the cult's strength
success_text_en: Fanaticism becomes the cult's strength.
fail_text_en: The fanaticism becomes a social problem.

label: 신도 복지에 쓴다
label_en: Spend it on the followers' welfare
success_text_en: The welfare eases the followers' lives.

label: 교단 건물을 짓는다
success_text_en: The new building expands the cult.
fail_text_en: Construction costs a lot.

label: 비상금으로 둔다
label_en: Keep it as an emergency fund
success_text_en: The emergency fund brings stability.

label: 당신의 생활을 윤택하게 한다
success_text_en: Your life grows comfortable.
fail_text_en: Word of your luxury gets around.

label: 경호원을 고용한다
success_text_en: The bodyguards protect the vault.
fail_text_en: The security costs weigh on you.

label: 재산을 분산한다
success_text_en: Spreading out the assets reduces risk.
fail_text_en: Managing it all separately is a hassle.

label: 모두 사회에 환원한다
label_en: Give it all back to society
success_text_en: Giving back to society improves the cult's image.

label: 투자로 불린다
success_text_en: Investment grows your Wealth.
fail_text_en: The investment fails, and your Wealth shrinks.

label: 당신의 재산을 내놓는다
success_text_en: You give up your fortune, and the followers are moved.
fail_text_en: Your fortune isn't enough.

label: 긴급 헌금을 호소한다
