success_text_en: A few emergency Offerings trickle in.
fail_text_en: Your appeal falls on deaf ears.

label: 기도로 버틴다
success_text_en: The followers endure through prayer.

label: 빚을 낸다
success_text_en: The loan puts out the immediate fire.
fail_text_en: Debt collectors come calling.

label: 일부러 반대 의견을 청한다
success_text: 반대 의견을 청하자 측근들이 믿음을 줍니다.
success_text_en: Inviting dissent wins your inner circle's trust.

label: 이 침묵을 즐긴다
success_text_en: The silence cements your Authority.
fail_text_en: The silence gives rise to talk of dictatorship.

label: 더 큰 권한을 요구한다
success_text_en: Your authority grows.
fail_text_en: Your demand for authority provokes your inner circle.

label: 측근들을 시험한다
success_text_en: The test reveals who in your inner circle is loyal.
fail_text_en: The test shatters your inner circle's trust.

label: 그 힘을 자비롭게 쓴다
success_text_en: Your merciful commands embrace the followers.

label: 그 힘으로 반대파를 정리한다
label_en: Use that power to purge the opposition
success_text_en: The opposition is purged, and all falls quiet.
fail_text_en: The purge becomes known outside.

label: 권한을 측근들에게 나눈다
label_en: Share authority with your inner circle
success_text_en: Sharing authority wins the followers' trust.

label: 신이 되기를 꿈꾼다
success_text_en: Your divine ambition shakes the cult.
fail_text_en: Your ambition becomes the world's laughingstock.

label: 침묵 수행에 들어간다
success_text_en: In silence, your faith ripens.
fail_text_en: The practice goes too far and harms your body.

label: 교리를 다시 쓴다
success_text_en: The rewritten Doctrine gains depth.
fail_text_en: The revision of Doctrine causes confusion.

label: 무릎 꿇고 경배한다
success_text_en: After worship, your heart grows calm.

label: 신도들에게 증언한다
success_text_en: Your testimony sets the followers ablaze.
fail_text_en: Your testimony is criticized as exaggerated.

label: 신에게 질문을 던진다
success_text: 질문 끝에 떠오른 답이 교리가 됩니다.
success_text_en: The answer that comes to you after asking becomes Doctrine.
fail_text_en: There is no answer to your question.

label: 환각이라 의심한다
success_text_en: Suspecting a hallucination, you show prudence.

label: 더 깊이 들어간다
success_text_en: A deeper Communion comes upon you.
fail_text_en: You collapse during Communion.

label: 잠시 멈추고 휴식한다
success_text_en: Rest restores body and mind.

label: 신도들과 경험을 나눈다
label_en: Share the experience with the followers
success_text_en: Sharing the experience binds the followers together.
fail_text_en: The experience confuses the followers.

label: 병자를 치유해 본다
success_text_en: Word of the Healing spreads and draws followers.
fail_text_en: The Healing fails, and talk of fraud goes around.

label: 힘을 숨긴다
success_text_en: Hiding the power, you keep your peace.

label: 힘으로 신도를 복종시킨다
label_en: Use the power to make followers obey
success_text_en: Obedience establishes order.
fail_text_en: Forced obedience provokes backlash.

label: 힘의 근원을 탐구한다
label_en: Explore the source of the power
success_text_en: Your exploration broadens the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The exploration leads nowhere.

label: 신의 뜻을 세상에 전한다
label_en: Spread god's will to the world
success_text_en: God's will spreads across the world.
fail_text_en: The world doubts god's will.

label: 그 힘을 혼자 간직한다
success_text_en: Keeping the power, you find stillness.

label: 신과 하나가 되기를 택한다
label_en: Choose to become one with god
success_text: 신과 하나가 된 듯한 체험이 찾아옵니다.
success_text_en: You feel as if you have become one with god.
fail_text_en: Your body begins to break down.

label: 교리 학교를 연다
success_text_en: The Doctrine school raises up followers.
fail_text_en: The school's running costs weigh on you.

label: 교리를 외부에 공개한다
success_text_en: Making the Doctrine public earns trust.

label: 이단을 파문한다
success_text_en: The excommunication restores discipline.
fail_text_en: The excommunication is called harsh.

label: 토론회를 연다
success_text_en: The debate refines the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The debate gets rowdy.

label: 이단의 주장을 흡수한다
success_text_en: The heretics' claims are absorbed into the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The absorption muddies the Doctrine.

label: 무시한다
success_text_en: You ignore it.

label: 학자들과 교류한다
success_text_en: Engaging with scholars makes the Doctrine shine.
fail_text_en: The engagement invites criticism.

label: 교리를 비밀로 닫는다
success_text_en: Secrecy deepens the Doctrine's mystery.
fail_text_en: The secrecy invites suspicion.

label: 대규모 봉사로 만회한다
label_en: Make up for it with large-scale service
success_text_en: The service restores your Repute.
fail_text_en: The service has no effect.

label: 신도들에게 인내를 설교한다
success_text_en: The sermon on Patience steadies the followers.
fail_text_en: The sermon rings hollow.

label: 언론에 맞선다
success_text_en: Standing firm shows the cult's spirit.
fail_text_en: Standing firm backfires.

label: 잠시 활동을 멈춘다
success_text_en: You halt activities to stay out of sight.

label: 조사에 성실히 협조한다
success_text_en: Your cooperation wins back trust.
fail_text_en: The investigation's findings go against you.

label: 증거를 없앤다
success_text_en: The evidence disappears.
fail_text_en: The destruction of evidence is exposed.

label: 해외로 거점을 옮긴다
success_text_en: Moving your base lets you evade the investigation.
fail_text_en: The move scatters the followers.

label: 희생양을 내세운다
success_text_en: The scapegoat steers the investigation elsewhere.
fail_text_en: The scapegoat is exposed, and it backfires.

label: 감사 행사를 연다
success_text: 감사 행사가 지역 주민들과 가까워지게 합니다.
success_text_en: The thanksgiving event brings you closer to the locals.

label: 정치에 진출한다
success_text_en: Entering politics expands your power.
fail_text_en: Entering politics draws criticism.

label: 겸손을 잃지 않는다
success_text_en: Humility protects your Reputation.

label: 명성을 이용해 포교한다
success_text_en: Your fame draws in followers.
fail_text_en: The proselytizing looks exploitative.

label: 신앙 수련회를 연다
success_text_en: The retreat deepens their faith.
fail_text_en: The retreat is grueling, and complaints arise.

label: 얕은 신도를 정리한다
success_text_en: After the purge, the remaining followers stand firm.
fail_text_en: Some say the purge was harsh.

label: 믿음보다 숫자가 중요하다
success_text_en: Numbers grow the cult.
fail_text_en: Some call it mere window dressing.

label: 당신이 직접 신도들을 만난다
success_text_en: Meeting them in person holds on to the followers' hearts.

label: 헌금을 사회에 환원한다
label_en: Give the Offerings back to society
success_text_en: Giving back greatly restores your Repute.
fail_text_en: Some say it came too late.

label: 평판 따위 신경 쓰지 않는다
success_text_en: Unbothered, you focus on finances.

label: 홍보에 돈을 쓴다
success_text_en: Publicity slightly raises your Repute.
fail_text_en: The publicity is mocked as exaggeration.

label: 돈의 흐름을 공개한다
success_text_en: Transparent disclosure clears away suspicion.
fail_text_en: Questions arise about the disclosed records.

label: 권위를 내려놓고 다가간다
label_en: Set aside your Authority and reach out
success_text_en: Reaching out wins back the followers' hearts.

label: 공포로 다스린다
success_text_en: Fear keeps order for now.
fail_text_en: Fear drives the followers away.

label: 측근을 통해 민심을 살핀다
label_en: Gauge sentiment through your inner circle
success_text_en: Your inner circle reports the mood of the people.
fail_text_en: Your inner circle's reports conflict.

label: 기적을 연출한다
success_text: 연출된 기적이 신도들의 마음을 잠시 붙잡습니다.
success_text_en: The staged miracle holds the followers' hearts for a while.
fail_text_en: The staging is found out.

label: 모든 것을 내려놓고 기도한다
label_en: Let go of everything and pray
success_text_en: Through prayer, you find your faith again.

label: 신앙 없이 교단을 운영한다
success_text_en: The operation keeps running, but faith grows dim.
fail_text_en: The emptiness of it all shows.

label: 측근에게 고백한다
success_text_en: The confession brings you closer to your inner circle.
fail_text_en: Your inner circle grows uneasy.

label: 쾌락에 빠진다
success_text_en: Pleasure fills the emptiness.
fail_text_en: Word of your pleasures gets around.

label: 연합을 제안한다
success_text_en: The alliance raises the cult's standing.
fail_text_en: The alliance proposal is rejected.

label: 정면으로 맞선다
success_text_en: Standing firm shows the cult's spirit.
fail_text_en: The confrontation deepens the strife.

label: 몸을 낮춘다
success_text_en: Lying low eases the pressure.

label: 경쟁 교단을 매수한다
success_text_en: With a payoff, the rival cult is absorbed.
fail_text_en: The payoff is exposed.

label: 경쟁 교단에 몰래 사람을 심는다
label_en: Plant a mole in the rival cult
success_text_en: Your mole shakes them from within.
fail_text_en: The infiltration is discovered.

label: 새 경전을 쓴다
success_text_en: The new scripture elevates the Doctrine.
fail_text_en: The scripture stirs controversy.

label: 계시를 의심한다
success_text_en: After doubting, you interpret the Revelation correctly.

label: 대축제를 연다
success_text_en: The grand festival boosts the followers' pride.
fail_text_en: The festival costs a lot.

label: 이 순간을 교리에 새긴다
label_en: Engrave this moment into the Doctrine
success_text_en: This moment becomes the pinnacle of the Doctrine.

label: 더 높은 곳을 바라본다
success_text_en: Gazing upward, you feed your ambition.
fail_text_en: Your overreach becomes the talk of the town.

label: 함께 조용히 기도한다
success_text_en: The quiet prayer embraces everyone.

label: 주민들과 대화의 자리를 만든다
label_en: Arrange a dialogue with the residents
success_text_en: The dialogue calms the protest.
fail_text_en: The dialogue ends with nothing gained.

label: 시위를 무시한다
success_text_en: The protest dies down, but ill will remains.
fail_text_en: Ignoring it only grows the protest.

label: 신도들을 동원해 맞불 집회를 연다
success_text_en: The counter-rally unites the followers.
fail_text_en: The counter-rally escalates into a clash.

label: 당분간 집회를 멈춘다
success_text_en: You halt the gatherings and wait quietly.

label: 공개 토론을 제안한다
success_text: 토론 제안이 교단의 논리를 보여 줍니다.
success_text_en: Proposing a debate shows off the cult's reasoning.
fail_text_en: The debate never happens, which only hurts you.

label: 교리를 순화한다
success_text_en: The softened Doctrine eases outside concerns.
fail_text_en: The followers push back against the softening.

label: 그들을 맞비난한다
success_text_en: Trading accusations escalates the fight.
fail_text_en: The accusations come back at you.

label: 침묵한다
success_text_en: Silence buys you time.

label: 모든 자료를 제출한다
success_text_en: Submitting the records wins back trust.
fail_text_en: Some of the records become a problem.

label: 변호사를 고용해 맞선다
success_text_en: The lawyers defend the cult.
fail_text_en: The legal fees shake your finances.

label: 핵심 자료를 숨긴다
success_text_en: Hiding the records lets you evade the investigation.
fail_text_en: The hidden records are found.

label: 신도들에게 증언을 시킨다
success_text_en: The followers' testimony protects the cult.
fail_text_en: The testimony is suspected of being coached.

label: 교단 운영을 전면 쇄신한다
label_en: Overhaul how the cult is run
success_text_en: The overhaul keeps the cult alive.
fail_text_en: The overhaul is called too little, too late.

label: 사회 공헌을 약속하고 거액을 기부한다
label_en: Pledge to give back and donate a fortune
success_text_en: The huge donation turns public opinion.
fail_text_en: Some say the donation isn't enough.

label: 지하로 숨어든다
success_text_en: Underground, you protect your followers.
fail_text_en: The followers scatter in every direction.

label: 끝까지 맞선다
success_text_en: Fighting to the end, the followers band together.
fail_text_en: Your defiance becomes the pretext for dissolution.

label: 기꺼이 함께한다
success_text_en: The joint venture grows the cult's Repute.

label: 교단 이름을 앞세운다
label_en: Put the cult's name front and center
success_text_en: The cult's name becomes the heart of the venture.
fail_text_en: Putting your name up front provokes backlash.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: A polite refusal preserves your dignity.

label: 절차를 밟는다
success_text_en: Official incorporation raises the cult's standing.

label: 국가의 간섭을 거부한다
success_text_en: Rejecting interference protects the cult's independence.
fail_text_en: The rejection sparks conflict with the state.

label: 세제 혜택만 챙긴다
success_text_en: The tax breaks swell your finances.
fail_text_en: Critics say you're only in it for the benefits.

label: 진솔하게 인터뷰한다
success_text_en: The candid interview earns respect.
fail_text_en: The interview is marred by slips of the tongue.

label: 교단의 비전을 크게 선포한다
success_text_en: The proclamation raises the followers' expectations.
fail_text_en: Some say the proclamation is overblown.

label: 언론을 피한다
success_text_en: Avoiding the press, you keep the peace.

label: 가족들을 직접 만나 설득한다
label_en: Meet the families yourself and persuade them
success_text_en: Meeting in person softens the families' anger.
fail_text_en: Your persuasion only fuels the families' resentment.

label: 신도들에게 가족과 연을 끊으라 한다
label_en: Tell the followers to cut ties with their families
success_text_en: Followers who cut ties become loyal to the cult.
fail_text_en: The families press their lawsuit harder.

label: 합의금을 준비한다
success_text_en: The settlement calms the situation.
fail_text_en: The settlement money falls short.

label: 신도들의 귀가를 허락한다
success_text_en: Letting them go home makes the families back off.

label: 금식하며 매달린다
success_text: 금식 끝에 겨우 마음의 평정을 되찾지만 몸이 상합니다.
success_text_en: After the fast, you barely regain your composure, but your body suffers.
fail_text_en: You collapse and fall ill, and the cult is thrown into a stir.

label: 아무렇지 않은 척 설교를 이어 간다
label_en: Carry on preaching as if nothing is wrong
success_text_en: The sermon was hollow, but no one notices.
fail_text_en: Your words ring false, and the followers tilt their heads.

label: 기도를 접고 일에만 매달린다
label_en: Give up prayer and bury yourself in work
success_text: 교단 일은 굴러가지만 신앙은 더 메말라 갑니다.
success_text_en: The cult's work keeps rolling, but your faith withers further.
fail_text: 일마저 꼬여 모든 것이 허사가 됩니다.
fail_text_en: Even the work goes awry, and it all comes to nothing.

label: 솔직히 흔들린다고 고백한다
success_text: 솔직한 고백에 몇몇 신도가 눈시울을 붉히지만 교단의 위엄은 흔들립니다.
success_text_en: Your honest confession brings tears to a few followers, but the cult's dignity is shaken.
fail_text_en: Your confession is taken as weakness, and the followers whisper.

label: 찬송가를 불러 시간을 번다
label_en: Sing a hymn to buy time
success_text_en: The hymn gets you through, but the cold sweat won't stop.
fail_text: 찬송마저 음정이 흔들려 웃음이 새어 나옵니다.
fail_text_en: Even the hymn wavers off-key, and laughter slips out.

label: 집회를 파한다
success_text: 집회를 서둘러 마쳤지만 소문은 막지 못합니다.
success_text_en: You end the gathering in a hurry, but you can't stop the rumors.
fail_text_en: The hasty dismissal looks like running away.

label: 신도들을 일일이 찾아가 이야기를 듣는다
label_en: Visit each follower and hear them out
success_text: 속마음을 들어 주자 한숨 섞인 불만이 쏟아집니다.
success_text_en: When you listen, sighing complaints come pouring out.
fail_text: 대화가 푸념으로 끝나 사기만 더 떨어집니다.
fail_text_en: The talks end in griping, and morale sinks further.

label: 더 강한 어조로 설교한다
success_text: 목청을 높이자 잠시 긴장하지만 마음은 얻지 못합니다.
success_text_en: Raising your voice makes them tense for a moment, but wins no hearts.
fail_text: 고함이 반발을 사 몇몇이 자리를 뜹니다.
fail_text_en: Your shouting provokes backlash, and some walk out.

label: 집회를 쉰다
success_text: 쉬는 동안 신도들이 한숨을 돌리지만 열기는 식어 갑니다.
success_text_en: During the break, the followers catch their breath, but their fervor cools.
fail_text_en: Taking a break sounds like giving up.

label: 조용히 보내 준다
success_text: 축복해 보낸 뒤 가까운 신도 몇이 같이 떠날 기색입니다.
success_text_en: After you send them off with a blessing, a few close followers look ready to leave too.
fail_text: 보내 준 뒤 그가 밖에서 교단 험담을 하고 다닙니다.
fail_text_en: After you let him go, he goes around badmouthing the cult.

label: 공개적으로 설득한다
success_text_en: Persuaded, the follower hesitates and sits back down.
fail_text: 설득이 말싸움으로 번져 그가 문을 박차고 나갑니다.
fail_text_en: The persuasion turns into an argument, and he storms out the door.

label: 배신자라 꾸짖는다
success_text_en: Your rebuke silences the other followers.
fail_text: 꾸짖음이 반감을 사 다른 신도들도 등을 돌립니다.
fail_text_en: Your rebuke breeds resentment, and other followers turn away too.

label: 그 모임에 직접 찾아가 따진다
success_text_en: He reluctantly backs down, but bad blood remains.
fail_text: 신도들 앞에서 말싸움이 벌어져 권위가 땅에 떨어집니다.
fail_text_en: An argument breaks out in front of the followers, and your Authority hits the floor.

label: 모른 척 두고 본다
label_en: Pretend not to notice and wait
success_text_en: The group never grows and fizzles out.
fail_text_en: The group swells, and the cult splits in two.

label: 측근을 파문한다
success_text: 파문으로 일단 정리되었지만 그를 따르던 이들이 떠납니다.
success_text_en: The excommunication settles things for now, but his supporters leave.
fail_text: 파문이 도리어 반발을 불러 교단이 어수선해집니다.
fail_text_en: The excommunication sparks backlash instead, and the cult is thrown into disarray.

label: 자리를 내놓겠다고 맞받아친다
label_en: Fire back that you'll step down
success_text_en: Faced with your nerve, he loses steam and backs down.
fail_text: 그가 정말 자리를 차지하려 해 교단이 술렁입니다.
fail_text_en: He actually tries to take your place, and the cult is thrown into a stir.

label: 경호를 불러 끌어낸다
label_en: Call security to drag him out
success_text_en: The commotion dies down, but a harsh impression lingers.
fail_text: 끌려 나가며 그가 소리쳐 더 큰 구설이 됩니다.
fail_text_en: He shouts as he's dragged out, creating an even bigger scandal.

label: 조용히 타이른다
success_text_en: He flushes red and backs down.
fail_text: 타이름이 약해 보여 박수가 더 커집니다.
fail_text_en: Your admonishment looks weak, and the applause grows louder.

label: 신도들에게 호소해 월세를 마련한다
label_en: Appeal to the followers to cover the rent
success_text: 푼돈을 모아 간신히 막았지만 신도들의 표정이 어둡습니다.
success_text_en: You scrape together loose change and barely cover it, but the followers look grim.
fail_text: 모인 돈이 모자라 주인이 얼굴을 찌푸립니다.
fail_text_en: The money falls short, and the landlord frowns.

label: 개인 물건을 팔아 낸다
success_text: 시계와 외투를 팔아 한 달을 넘깁니다.
success_text_en: You sell your watch and coat to get through the month.
fail_text_en: You sell them for a pittance and still come up short.

label: 빌려서 막는다
success_text_en: A loan with interest gets you through for now.
fail_text_en: A creditor shows up at the meeting hall, causing a scene.

label: 신도들의 집에서 연탄을 얻어 온다
label_en: Gather coal briquettes from followers' homes
success_text: 신도들의 정성으로 몇 장을 얻어 불을 지핍니다.
success_text_en: Your followers spare a few briquettes out of devotion, and you light a fire.
fail_text_en: They are struggling too; all you get are uneasy glances.

label: 집회를 따뜻한 신도 집에서 연다
label_en: Hold the gathering in a follower's warm home
success_text_en: Crammed into a small room, you all keep warm with each other's body heat.
fail_text: 좁은 방에서 몸이 상한 신도가 생깁니다.
fail_text_en: In the cramped room, a follower falls ill.

label: 예배를 취소한다
success_text: 추위 속 모임은 접었지만 마음은 더 식습니다.
success_text_en: You skip gathering in the cold, but hearts grow colder still.
fail_text_en: The cancellations drag on, and followers stop coming.

label: 홀로 예배를 올린다
success_text: 홀로 올린 예배가 쓸쓸하지만 마음은 다잡습니다.
success_text_en: A service held alone is lonely, but it steadies your resolve.
fail_text_en: The hollow echo leaves your chest aching.

label: 신도들의 집을 찾아 나선다
success_text: 찾아간 집에서 문전박대를 당해도 몇이 마음을 돌립니다.
success_text_en: Doors slam in your face, but a few have a change of heart.
fail_text: 닫힌 문 앞에서 한참을 서성이다 돌아옵니다.
fail_text_en: You linger at a closed door for a long while, then turn back.

label: 오늘은 집회를 접는다
success_text_en: Calling off the gathering weighs on you.
fail_text: 접은 일이 소문이 나 교단이 문 닫았다는 말이 돕니다.
fail_text_en: Word gets out, and people say the cult has shut its doors.

label: 웃으며 보내 준다
label_en: Send him off with a smile
success_text: 웃는 얼굴로 보냈지만 돌아선 뒷모습이 쓸쓸합니다.
success_text_en: You see him off smiling, but his retreating back looks lonely.
fail_text_en: Your smile is so stiff he feels even worse.

label: 함께 가자고 붙잡는다
label_en: Ask him to stay with you
success_text: 그가 흔들리며 한 달만 더 있겠다고 합니다.
success_text_en: He wavers and agrees to stay one more month.
fail_text_en: He shakes off your hand and leaves.

label: 새 신도를 소개해 달라 부탁한다
label_en: Ask him to introduce a new follower
success_text: 소개받은 이웃이 한번 들러 보겠다고 합니다.
success_text_en: The neighbor he introduces says they'll drop by once.
fail_text: 민망한 부탁에 그가 얼굴을 붉히며 서둘러 자리를 뜹니다.
fail_text_en: Embarrassed by the request, he flushes and hurries away.

label: 즉석에서 그럴듯하게 둘러댄다
success_text: 둘러댄 말이 그럴듯해 청년이 고개를 끄덕입니다.
success_text_en: Your answer sounds convincing, and the young man nods.
fail_text: 앞뒤가 맞지 않아 청년이 코웃음을 칩니다.
fail_text_en: It doesn't add up, and the young man scoffs.

label: 정직하게 아직 준비 중이라 답한다
label_en: Admit honestly that it's still in progress
success_text_en: Your honesty earns respect, but it exposes how thin the cult really is.
fail_text_en: "Still in progress" draws mocking laughter.

label: 화를 내며 질문을 막는다
label_en: Get angry and shut down the question
success_text: 다그침에 청년이 입을 다물지만 분위기는 싸늘합니다.
success_text_en: Your scolding silences him, but the mood turns icy.
fail_text: 청년이 소문을 퍼뜨려 교단이 사이비라는 말이 돕니다.
fail_text_en: The young man spreads word that the cult is a sham.

label: 기억을 더듬어 다시 쓴다
success_text_en: You wring your memory and restore part of it.
fail_text_en: Wrong verses get mixed in, and the Doctrine goes astray.

label: 남은 부분만 정리한다
success_text: 남은 문장만 추려 짧은 교리로 만듭니다.
success_text_en: You pick out the surviving sentences and form a short Doctrine.
fail_text: 추린 문장이 앞뒤가 안 맞아 흩어집니다.
fail_text_en: The pieces don't fit together and fall apart.

label: 신도들의 기억을 모은다
success_text: 신도들이 외운 구절을 모아 겨우 복원합니다.
success_text_en: You piece it back together from verses your followers memorized.
fail_text_en: Everyone remembers it differently, and arguments break out.

label: 의식을 다시 시도한다
success_text: 두 번째 시도 끝에 희미한 기척을 느낍니다.
success_text_en: On the second try, you sense a faint presence.
fail_text_en: Failure after failure leaves your head spinning.

label: 접신이 이루어진 척한다
success_text_en: Your convincing act fools the followers.
fail_text_en: A follower sees through your clumsy act and whispers about it.

label: 의식을 멈추고 솔직히 말한다
label_en: Stop the ritual and tell the truth
success_text_en: Your honest confession leaves the followers speechless.
fail_text: 고백이 무력하게 들려 몇몇이 믿음을 거둡니다.
fail_text_en: The confession sounds feeble, and some lose their faith.

label: 불안을 누르고 의식을 끝낸다
label_en: Suppress your unease and finish the ritual
success_text_en: You complete the ritual with trembling hands.
fail_text: 의식을 이어 가다 비명을 지르며 쓰러집니다.
fail_text_en: Midway through the ritual, you scream and collapse.

label: 신도들을 불러 곁에 앉힌다
label_en: Call your followers to sit beside you
success_text_en: With your followers near, the anxiety eases a little.
fail_text_en: Your followers see you rattled.

label: 밤새 불을 켜 두고 잠을 설친다
label_en: Leave the lights on and lie awake all night
success_text_en: You stay up until dawn beneath the light.
fail_text_en: The sleepless nights leave you sick for days.

label: 직접 지운다
success_text: 직접 지우는 모습에 이웃 몇이 안쓰럽게 쳐다봅니다.
success_text_en: Seeing you scrub it yourself, a few neighbors look on with pity.
fail_text: 지워도 다음 날 다시 쓰여 헛수고가 됩니다.
fail_text_en: You scrub it off, but it's back the next day. Wasted effort.

label: 범인을 찾겠다고 나선다
success_text: 범인을 찾아 사과를 받지만 이웃의 불신은 가시지 않습니다.
success_text_en: You find the culprit and get an apology, but the neighbors' distrust lingers.
fail_text_en: You accuse the wrong neighbor, and distrust grows.

label: 무시하고 지나간다
success_text_en: Once ignored, the graffiti spreads no further.
fail_text: 낙서가 번져 교단 이름이 동네 골목마다 적힙니다.
fail_text_en: The graffiti spreads until the cult's name covers every alley in the neighborhood.

label: 성실히 조사에 응한다
success_text: 경찰이 아무 문제가 없음을 확인하고 돌아갑니다.
success_text_en: The police find nothing wrong and leave.
fail_text_en: The investigation drags on, and followers grow uneasy.

label: 신도들을 불러 항의한다
success_text: 신도들의 기세에 경찰이 물러서지만 인상은 나빠집니다.
success_text_en: The police back off before the angry followers, but it leaves a bad impression.
fail_text_en: The standoff turns into a commotion and makes the papers.

label: 변호사를 선임한다
success_text: 변호사 덕에 조사는 끝나지만 비용이 듭니다.
success_text_en: The lawyer ends the investigation, but it costs you.
fail_text_en: It costs money, and the investigation goes on anyway.

label: 함께 즐기며 흥을 돋운다
label_en: Join in and liven up the party
success_text_en: People flock to the festive dinner.

label: 가장 값진 잔을 내 앞에 놓는다
label_en: Set the most precious goblet before yourself
success_text_en: Everyone marvels at your refinement.

label: 직접 설계도를 펼친다
success_text_en: Before the blueprints, followers' Offerings keep pouring in.

label: 신도 대표에게 맡긴다
label_en: Leave it to the follower representatives
success_text_en: The representatives race each other to raise funds.

label: 이 옷으로 설교단에 오른다
label_en: Take the pulpit in this robe
success_text_en: Below the pulpit, everyone falls breathlessly silent.

label: 가난한 이들에게 나눠 준다
success_text: 옷을 받은 이들이 감사의 노래를 부릅니다.
success_text_en: Those who receive the clothes sing songs of thanks.

label: 후원을 받고 자리를 준다
label_en: Accept the sponsorship and grant a seat
success_text_en: The donations flow in, and the local notable saves face.

label: 정중히 감사를 표하고 받는다
success_text: 예의 바른 후원에 교단의 평판이 오릅니다.
success_text_en: Your gracious acceptance raises the cult's Repute.

label: 분수 앞에서 축복을 내린다
success_text: 분수 앞의 기도 소리가 밤까지 이어집니다.
success_text_en: Prayers before the fountain continue late into the night.

label: 분수의 물을 병에 담아 판다
label_en: Bottle and sell the fountain water
success_text: 성수 병이 날개 돋친 듯 팔립니다.
success_text_en: The holy water bottles sell like hotcakes.

label: 문을 활짝 열어 입문을 권한다
label_en: Throw the doors open to all initiates
success_text_en: The line of initiates stretches out the door.

label: 초대장만 발행한다
success_text_en: Those who get invitations show them off to each other.

label: 땅을 개발해 상가를 짓는다
label_en: Develop the land into a shopping arcade
success_text: 상가 임대료가 교단 금고로 쏟아져 들어옵니다.
success_text_en: Rent from the arcade pours into the cult's coffers.

label: 보상금을 받아 교단 기금으로 쌓는다
label_en: Take the compensation for the cult's fund
success_text: 넉넉한 보상금에 신도들이 교단의 앞날을 낙관합니다.
success_text_en: With generous compensation in hand, followers feel hopeful about the cult's future.

label: 초상화 앞에서 기도회를 연다
label_en: Hold a prayer meeting before the portrait
success_text: 기도회에 모인 신도들이 감격의 눈물을 흘립니다.
success_text_en: The followers at the prayer meeting weep tears of joy.

label: 초상화를 보며 웃어넘긴다
success_text_en: Your easygoing attitude earns even more respect.

label: 보석을 성물로 모신다
label_en: Enshrine the jewel as a relic
success_text_en: The jewel gleams at the center of the altar.

label: 보석을 팔아 자선 학교를 세운다
label_en: Sell the jewel to found a charity school
success_text: 학교 문을 연 날, 동네 사람들이 환호합니다.
success_text_en: On the day the school opens, the locals cheer.

label: 군중 앞에서 더 큰 약속을 한다
label_en: Make an even bigger promise to the crowd
success_text_en: The crowd answers your promise with one voice.

label: 조용히 손짓만 한다
success_text: 침묵이 오히려 군중을 더 고요하게 만듭니다.
success_text_en: Your silence hushes the crowd even further.

label: 보좌관을 귀한 손님으로 맞는다
label_en: Welcome the aide as an honored guest
success_text: 보좌관은 교단의 위세를 높이 평가하며 돌아갑니다.
success_text_en: The aide leaves impressed by the cult's clout.

label: 행사 비용을 신도 모금으로 충당한다
label_en: Fund the event with follower donations
success_text_en: Followers eagerly volunteer to raise money.

label: 향으로 신비를 연출한다
label_en: Use the incense to stage a mystery
success_text: 향 연기 속 예배에 신도들이 황홀해합니다.
success_text_en: Followers are enraptured by the service wreathed in incense smoke.

label: 향을 상인에게 되판다
success_text_en: The incense money fills the cult's coffers.

label: 종을 성대히 울린다
success_text_en: The bell's peal carries to the edge of town.

label: 종 제작비를 기부자 이름으로 새긴다
label_en: Engrave donors' names to fund the bell
success_text_en: Donors beam with pride at seeing their names.

label: 사업가를 교단의 후견인으로 세운다
label_en: Make the businessman the cult's patron
success_text_en: The patron's pledge solidifies the cult's foundation.

label: 사업가와 함께 식사한다
success_text_en: The bond forged over dinner deepens.

label: 공연을 교리 축제로 꾸민다
label_en: Turn the show into a Doctrine festival
success_text_en: The festival runs all night, and word spreads.

label: 공연 수익을 교단 금고로 옮긴다
label_en: Move the show's earnings into the cult's coffers
success_text_en: The earnings fill the cult's coffers to the brim.

label: 당당히 거절하고 명성을 얻는다
success_text_en: The cult's Reputation for independence grows.

label: 조건부로 흡수하여 세력을 키운다
label_en: Absorb them on your terms and grow stronger
success_text_en: The absorbed followers become your new family.

label: 방에서 개인 상담을 연다
label_en: Hold private counseling in the room
success_text_en: Counseled followers are deeply grateful.

label: 방을 전시 공간으로 개방한다
label_en: Open the room as an exhibition space
success_text_en: An endless stream of people come to see the room.

label: 유행을 교리에 녹여 낸다
success_text: 유행과 교리가 어우러져 새 흐름이 생깁니다.
success_text_en: Trend and Doctrine blend into a new movement.

label: 정해진 색 옷을 교단 복식으로 정한다
label_en: Make the set colors the cult's official attire
success_text_en: The cult's attire becomes a symbol of order.

label: 성찬에 쓰인다
success_text_en: The communion cup binds the followers as one.

label: 귀빈에게만 따른다
label_en: Pour it only for distinguished guests
success_text_en: The distinguished guests decide to become the cult's patrons.

label: 독대에서 큰 헌금을 받는다
label_en: Accept a large donation in private
success_text_en: The businessman leaves behind a fat envelope.

label: 사업가의 장부를 공개 감사에 맡긴다
label_en: Submit the businessman's books to a public audit
success_text_en: Transparent dealings boost trust in the cult.

label: 직접 밥을 나눠 준다
success_text_en: Warm soup brightens people's faces.

label: 자원봉사자를 모집한다
success_text_en: The volunteers become a community that helps one another.

label: 서약식을 공개로 연다
label_en: Hold the vow ceremony in public
success_text_en: Many attend the public vow ceremony.

label: 서약자끼리 공동체를 만든다
label_en: Form a community of the sworn
success_text_en: The sworn call each other brother and sister.

label: 정성껏 기도해 준다
success_text_en: The mother thanks you through her tears.

label: 치료비를 교단이 부담한다
label_en: Have the cult cover the medical bills
success_text_en: When the child recovers, word spreads through the neighborhood.

label: 화해의 식탁을 마련한다
success_text_en: The two families laugh together at the same table.

label: 중재인으로 나선다
success_text_en: Your fair mediation wins praise.

label: 보육원을 교단 이름으로 세운다
label_en: Found an orphanage in the cult's name
success_text: 보육원 개원식에 많은 이가 축하를 보냅니다.
success_text_en: Many send congratulations to the orphanage's opening.

label: 신도 가정이 나눠 맡도록 한다
label_en: Have follower families share the care
success_text: 가정마다 아이들을 품는 따뜻한 온기가 번집니다.
success_text_en: The warmth of homes embracing children spreads.

label: 장부를 모든 신도에게 공개한다
label_en: Open the books to every follower
success_text_en: Transparent books strengthen the followers' faith.

label: 감사위원회를 구성한다
success_text_en: The committee establishes the cult's rules.

label: 고백을 축하하는 예배를 연다
label_en: Hold a service celebrating the confession
success_text_en: The chapel fills with hymns of thanks.

label: 그의 헌신을 교리 사례로 기록한다
label_en: Record his devotion as a Doctrinal example
success_text: 기록된 사례는 후배 신도들의 본보기가 됩니다.
success_text_en: The recorded example becomes a model for newer followers.

label: 임금을 올려 준다
success_text: 노동자들이 교단에 더 큰 충성을 보입니다.
success_text_en: The workers show the cult even greater loyalty.

label: 농장 수익을 장학금으로 돌린다
label_en: Turn the farm's profits into scholarships
success_text_en: The scholarship students become the cult's pride.

label: 모인 물품을 구호품으로 쓴다
label_en: Use the donated goods as relief supplies
success_text_en: The relief supplies reach everywhere they're needed.

label: 물품을 교단 기금으로 쌓는다
label_en: Store the goods in the cult's fund
success_text_en: The fund becomes the cult's solid reserve.

label: 봉사단을 파견한다
success_text_en: The service team brings comfort to every bedside.

label: 의사 신도를 후원해 참여시킨다
label_en: Sponsor follower doctors to take part
success_text_en: The doctors' devotion is remembered in the name of the Doctrine.

label: 그 뜻대로 기금을 운영한다
label_en: Run the fund as he wished
success_text: 그의 뜻은 많은 이의 삶을 바꿉니다.
success_text_en: His wishes change many lives.

label: 그의 이름으로 추모 예배를 드린다
label_en: Hold a memorial service in his name
success_text: 추모 예배에서 신도들이 함께 울고 웃습니다.
success_text_en: At the memorial, followers weep and laugh together.

label: 직접 우물 파는 일에 나선다
success_text_en: Clear water springs from the parched earth.

label: 신도들의 모금으로 우물을 판다
label_en: Dig the well with followers' donations
success_text: 모금에 참여한 모두가 우물을 함께 지은 셈입니다.
success_text_en: Everyone who donated helped build the well together.

label: 감사를 받아들여 투명성을 과시한다
label_en: Accept the audit and flaunt your transparency
success_text: 정직한 감사 결과가 교단의 명예가 됩니다.
success_text_en: The clean audit becomes a badge of honor for the cult.

label: 감사 결과를 신도에게 알린다
label_en: Share the audit results with followers
success_text_en: Followers trust the cult even more.

label: 찬송을 예배의 중심으로 삼는다
label_en: Make hymns the heart of the service
success_text_en: The hymns unite every heart.

label: 찬송 악보를 마을에 나눠 준다
label_en: Hand out hymn sheets in the village
success_text_en: Hymns ring out all across the village.

label: 그를 후계자로 세운다
success_text_en: Naming a successor brightens the cult's future.

label: 그를 자선 사업 책임자로 임명한다
label_en: Appoint him head of charity work
success_text: 그의 헌신은 더 많은 이를 돕습니다.
success_text_en: His devotion helps even more people.

label: 임시 거처를 열어 준다
success_text_en: Warm lights glow in every shelter.

label: 그들을 신도로 맞아 공동체를 세운다
label_en: Welcome them as followers and build a community
success_text_en: The new community becomes each other's pillar.

label: 교육을 교리와 함께 가르친다
success_text_en: The children learn letters and Doctrine together.

label: 교사들을 교단의 명예 직분으로 세운다
label_en: Grant the teachers honorary posts in the cult
success_text: 명예 직분을 받은 교사들이 자부심을 느낍니다.
success_text_en: The teachers take pride in their honorary posts.

label: 기적이라고 선언하지 않고 감사만 드린다
label_en: Give thanks without declaring a Miracle
success_text_en: Your humble gratitude draws followers closer.

label: 기적을 기념하는 축제를 연다
label_en: Hold a festival celebrating the Miracle
success_text_en: The festival lights brighten the night sky.

label: 수익금을 공개적으로 전달한다
success_text_en: The public handover moves everyone.

label: 수익금 일부를 교단 이름으로 전달한다
label_en: Donate part of the proceeds in the cult's name
success_text_en: The cult's name is engraved at every orphanage.

label: 함께 기도하며 신뢰를 쌓는다
success_text_en: A smile of relief spreads across the girl's face.

label: 그녀를 교단 대표로 세운다
label_en: Make her a representative of the cult
success_text: 소녀의 용기가 많은 신도에게 희망이 됩니다.
success_text_en: The girl's courage gives hope to many followers.

label: 귀를 기울여 끝까지 듣는다
success_text_en: When the sound fades, only certainty remains in your heart.
fail_text_en: Was it a hallucination? Your mind is troubled all night.

label: 조용히 기도를 마친다
success_text_en: You finish your prayer without wavering.
fail_text_en: You can't focus to the end.

label: 밤새 사본을 읽는다
success_text: 낯선 이의 기도가 당신의 믿음을 데웁니다.
success_text_en: A stranger's prayer warms your Faith.
fail_text_en: The more you read, the more doubts pile up, and you sleep poorly.

label: 신도들과 함께 낭독한다
label_en: Read it aloud with your followers
success_text_en: The prayer read together fills the chapel.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise that the reading is tedious.

label: 마지막 예배에 참석한다
success_text: 낡은 의자에 앉아 처음의 마음을 떠올립니다.
success_text_en: Seated on the worn pew, you recall how it felt at the beginning.
fail_text_en: In a place left only with memories, emptiness washes over you.

label: 교회를 사들여 지킨다
label_en: Buy the church to preserve it
success_text: 옛 교회는 교단의 작은 성지가 됩니다.
success_text_en: The old church becomes a small holy site for the cult.
fail_text_en: The sale falls through, and you lose the deposit.

label: 금식을 시작한다
success_text: 비워진 몸에 신의 목소리가 또렷이 울립니다.
success_text_en: In your emptied body, the voice of god rings clear.
fail_text_en: You collapse on the second day and break the fast.

label: 하루만 금식한다
success_text_en: The short fast lightens your heart.
fail_text_en: All you remember is the hunger.

label: 꿈을 신의 경고로 받아들인다
label_en: Take the dream as a divine warning
success_text_en: You resolve to walk your path more humbly.
fail_text_en: The warning turns to fear, and you hesitate.

label: 그냥 꿈으로 넘긴다
label_en: Dismiss it as just a dream
success_text_en: In the morning sun, the dream soon fades.
fail_text_en: Those words keep coming back to you.

label: 증언을 겸손히 받아들인다
success_text: 당신은 그 은혜가 신에게서 왔음을 압니다.
success_text_en: You know that grace came from god.
fail_text: 과연 내 기도 덕이었을까, 마음이 무겁습니다.
fail_text_en: Was it really your prayer? It weighs on your heart.

label: 기적이라고 널리 알린다
label_en: Proclaim it widely as a Miracle
success_text_en: As word spreads, people come seeking you.
fail_text_en: News of a relapse leaves you humiliated.

label: 기도원에 들어간다
success_text_en: In the clear air, your Faith grows firm.
fail_text_en: While you're away, the cult falls into disarray.

label: 초대를 정중히 사양한다
success_text_en: You believe protecting the cult is also an act of faith.
fail_text_en: You feel you've missed a chance.

label: 끝까지 들어 본다
label_en: Hear it out to the end
success_text: 반론을 곱씹으며 당신의 믿음이 더 깊어집니다.
success_text_en: Chewing over the counterarguments, your Faith deepens.
fail_text: 그의 말이 옳은 것 같아 흔들립니다.
fail_text_en: His words seem right, and you waver.

label: 라디오를 끈다
success_text_en: You quietly open your scripture.
fail_text_en: The voice from the silent radio lingers.

label: 신의 보호라 믿고 감사 예배를 연다
label_en: Hold a thanksgiving service for god's protection
success_text_en: You sing songs of thanks with your followers.
fail_text_en: Some whisper that it was mere coincidence.

label: 피뢰침을 손본다
success_text: 신의 보호도 사람의 준비가 함께여야 합니다.
success_text_en: Even god's protection needs human preparation.
fail_text_en: The repairs cost more than expected.

label: 병문안을 간다
success_text_en: Your mentor takes your hand and blesses you.
fail_text_en: Seeing your mentor so frail pains your heart.

label: 교단 일로 미룬다
label_en: Put it off for cult business
success_text_en: The cult runs smoothly, but a corner of your heart feels heavy.
fail_text_en: News of your mentor's death arrives first.

label: 밤새 기도한다
success_text_en: In the stillness, you feel as if you stand before god.
fail_text_en: The cold only wears out your body.

label: 신도들의 집을 찾아간다
success_text_en: You share warm tea in house after house.
fail_text_en: Some households are put out by the late visit.

label: 그 구절로 설교를 준비한다
label_en: Prepare a sermon from that verse
success_text_en: The meaning within the verse blossoms into a sermon.
fail_text_en: Your thoughts won't settle, and the sermon falls apart.

label: 일기에 적어 둔다
success_text_en: Putting it into words calms your heart.
fail_text_en: Even written down, the question remains unresolved.

label: 초창기 신도들을 불러 감사한다
label_en: Gather the early followers to thank them
success_text_en: The years spent together bring tears to everyone's eyes.
fail_text_en: The absence of those who left feels enormous.

label: 성대한 기념 예배를 연다
success_text: 기념 예배에 새 얼굴이 많이 보입니다.
success_text_en: Many new faces appear at the anniversary service.
fail_text_en: The preparations are lavish, but few people come.

label: 그와 대화를 나눈다
success_text_en: At daybreak, the young man follows you in tears.
fail_text_en: The argument ends with him shoving you to the ground.

label: 조용히 축복하고 지나친다
label_en: Quietly bless him and walk on
success_text_en: You say a brief prayer for him.
fail_text_en: His shouting lingers in your ears.

label: 기꺼이 집례한다
success_text: 평온히 눈을 감는 이를 보며 사명을 느낍니다.
success_text_en: Watching someone close their eyes in peace, you feel your calling.
fail_text_en: Before death, you are lost for words.

label: 젊은 전도사를 보낸다
success_text_en: The evangelist handles the task admirably.
fail_text_en: The family is hurt that the cult leader didn't come.

label: 신의 응답이라 믿는다
success_text_en: That warmth stays with you for a long time.
fail_text_en: It was an illusion born of exhaustion.

label: 의사를 찾아가 본다
success_text_en: You're relieved to hear you're in good health.
fail_text: 아무 이상 없다는 말에 오히려 허탈합니다.
fail_text_en: Being told nothing is wrong leaves you oddly deflated.

label: 가사를 직접 쓴다
success_text: 당신의 고백이 노래가 되어 울려 퍼집니다.
success_text_en: Your confession becomes a song that rings out.
fail_text: 가사가 영 어색해 서랍에 넣어 둡니다.
fail_text_en: The lyrics are so awkward you stash them in a drawer.

label: 기존 찬송가로 엮는다
success_text_en: The familiar songs give followers strength.
fail_text_en: A printer's error means it must be reprinted.

label: 들판에서 기우제 예배를 드린다
label_en: Hold a rain prayer service in the fields
success_text_en: Three days later, the long-awaited rain pours down.
fail_text_en: The sky stays stubbornly clear.

label: 비는 신의 뜻에 맡기자고 말한다
label_en: Say the rain is in god's hands
success_text_en: The followers nod in silence.
fail_text_en: Disappointed farmers turn away.

label: 그때의 열정을 되새긴다
label_en: Recall the passion you had then
success_text_en: Your forgotten first fervor comes back to life.
fail_text_en: You feel ashamed of who you've become.

label: 일기를 신도들에게 공개한다
label_en: Share the journal with your followers
success_text_en: Your candid confession moves the followers.
fail_text: 교주의 약한 모습에 실망하는 이도 있습니다.
fail_text_en: Some are disappointed to see the cult leader's weakness.

label: 안수하며 기도한다
success_text_en: The follower wakes and testifies in tears.
fail_text_en: An ambulance arrives, and the service ends in chaos.

label: 예배를 멈추고 병원으로 보낸다
label_en: Stop the service and send them to the hospital
success_text_en: Your careful response reassures the followers.
fail_text_en: The interruption takes the air out of the service.

label: 성경 속 이름을 지어 준다
success_text: 부모는 그 이름을 평생 자랑으로 여깁니다.
success_text_en: The parents treasure the name for the rest of their lives.
fail_text_en: Relatives object that the name sounds strange.

label: 축복 예배를 열어 준다
success_text_en: The whole cult rejoices at the child's birth.
fail_text_en: The service preparations just cost money.

label: 공개 기도회를 연다
success_text_en: After a night of prayer, the gossip dies down.
fail_text_en: People add that it was just for show.

label: 소문의 출처를 찾는다
label_en: Track down the source of the rumor
success_text_en: The one who spread it bows their head and apologizes.
fail_text_en: The questioning makes followers suspicious of one another.

label: 직접 찾아가 위로한다
label_en: Visit and comfort him in person
success_text_en: He returns to the chapel once more.
fail_text_en: Too ashamed, he won't open the door.

label: 교단에서 생활비를 돕는다
label_en: Have the cult help with living expenses
success_text: 도움 소식에 신도들이 서로를 더 챙깁니다.
success_text_en: News of the aid makes followers look out for each other more.
fail_text_en: He takes the help and leaves anyway.

label: 허락하고 함께 참석한다
label_en: Allow it and attend with them
success_text_en: The young people burn with fervor as praise goes on till dawn.
fail_text_en: Neighbors complain about the noise.

label: 자정까지만 허락한다
success_text_en: The compromise satisfies everyone.
fail_text_en: The young people grumble with disappointment.

label: 세대 연합 예배를 연다
label_en: Hold a joint service for both generations
success_text_en: The two generations learn each other's songs.
fail_text_en: Both sides only grow more dissatisfied.

label: 노년 신도 편을 든다
success_text_en: The elders are pleased, and order is restored.
fail_text: 청년 몇 명이 다른 교회로 옮깁니다.
fail_text_en: A few young people move to another church.

label: 가족을 직접 만나 설득한다
label_en: Meet the family and persuade them yourself
success_text_en: The whole family comes to the baptism.
fail_text_en: The family calls the cult heretical and threatens to report it.

label: 기다려 주겠다고 말한다
success_text_en: The follower thanks you for your consideration.
fail_text_en: In the end, the follower gives up.

label: 바닷가 수련원을 빌린다
success_text: 파도 소리 속 예배가 오래 기억됩니다.
success_text_en: The service amid the sound of waves is long remembered.
fail_text_en: A typhoon wrecks the schedule.

label: 교회 마당에서 소박하게 연다
label_en: Hold a simple one in the churchyard
success_text_en: It's cramped, but the retreat is heartwarming.
fail_text_en: Complaints arise that there's nothing to see.

label: 진지하게 들어 준다
success_text_en: His words give the followers hope.
fail_text: 그를 따르는 무리가 생겨 교주를 흔듭니다.
fail_text_en: A faction forms around him and shakes your leadership.

label: 계시는 교주에게만 온다고 정리한다
label_en: Declare that revelations come only to the cult leader
success_text_en: Order is restored.
fail_text_en: Hurt, the follower leaves the church.

label: 지원하고 응원한다
success_text_en: The choir brings home the silver prize.
fail_text_en: They're eliminated in the preliminaries, and spirits sink.

label: 예배에 집중하자고 말린다
label_en: Urge them to focus on services
success_text: 성가대는 예배 찬양을 더 정성껏 준비합니다.
success_text_en: The choir prepares worship hymns with even more care.
fail_text_en: A few choir members feel let down.

label: 모르는 척 기뻐한다
success_text_en: Everyone laughs at the surprise party.
fail_text_en: The plan is exposed, and things get awkward.

label: 헌금은 이웃에게 쓰자고 한다
label_en: Ask that the money go to neighbors in need
success_text_en: The followers are even more moved by your intent.
fail_text_en: The followers who planned it are deflated.

label: 교주의 칼럼을 싣는다
success_text_en: The newsletter is read in every home.
fail_text_en: It's riddled with spelling errors, and people tease you.

label: 신도들의 간증으로 채운다
success_text_en: Shared stories build empathy.
fail_text_en: A private story gets printed, and a quarrel breaks out.

label: 집집마다 기도 방문을 한다
label_en: Make prayer visits to every home
success_text_en: Sick followers are greatly comforted.
fail_text_en: You catch the flu too and are bedridden.

label: 예배를 한 주 쉬자고 공지한다
label_en: Announce a week off from services
success_text_en: The followers appreciate your consideration.
fail_text_en: Word spreads that your faith is weak.

label: 송별 예배를 열어 준다
success_text: 그는 새 동네에서도 교단을 알리겠다 약속합니다.
success_text_en: He promises to spread word of the cult in his new town.
fail_text_en: Everyone falls silent with regret.

label: 새 동네에 기도 모임을 맡긴다
label_en: Entrust him with a prayer group in the new town
success_text_en: A small group forms there.
fail_text_en: He quits, saying it's too much alone.

label: 상담을 맡는다
success_text_en: The couple enters the chapel hand in hand.
fail_text_en: You're accused of taking sides.

label: 시간에 맡긴다
success_text_en: A few months later, the couple reconciles.
fail_text_en: The quarrel spreads to other followers.

label: 교주가 직접 가르친다
success_text_en: The children tag along after you everywhere.
fail_text_en: You're exhausted, and your sermon falls flat.

label: 청년들에게 교사를 맡긴다
label_en: Put the young people in charge of teaching
success_text_en: The young people learn responsibility.
fail_text_en: Parents complain that the classes are a mess.

label: '평안을 빕니다'로 정한다
success_text_en: Everywhere, people recognize each other by that greeting.
fail_text_en: Many find it awkward and don't use it.

label: 신도 투표로 정한다
success_text: 모두가 함께 정한 인사에 애착을 갖습니다.
success_text_en: Everyone cherishes the greeting they chose together.
fail_text_en: The vote results spark an argument.

label: 병실에서 설교한다
success_text_en: The elderly follower closes their eyes with a peaceful face.
fail_text_en: The family is uncomfortable with talk of religion.

label: 녹음해서 보낸다
success_text_en: The elderly follower listens to the recording to the very end.
fail_text_en: The recorder breaks, and they never hear it.

label: 교주가 먼저 설거지를 한다
success_text_en: Everyone rushes to pitch in.
fail_text_en: Word spreads that the cult leader lacks dignity.

label: 순번표를 만든다
success_text_en: A fair rotation ends the squabbling.
fail_text_en: Some people skip their turns.

label: 위원회를 설득한다
success_text_en: The committee members finally come around to your view.
fail_text_en: You fail to persuade them and withdraw the decision.

label: 위원회 의견을 받아들인다
success_text_en: Your openness earns the committee's trust.
fail_text_en: People say the cult leader is indecisive.

label: 위엄 있게 꾸민다
success_text_en: Those who enter the office bow their heads.
fail_text_en: Critics call it extravagance.

label: 작은 방 하나면 충분하다고 한다
label_en: Say a small room is enough
success_text_en: Followers respect your modesty.
fail_text_en: Some say it lacks dignity.

label: 공개 토론으로 가린다
success_text_en: The debate brings order to the cult.
fail_text_en: The debate turns into a brawl.

label: 교주가 직접 지명한다
success_text: 지명에 따라 교단이 다시 하나로 움직입니다.
success_text_en: With the appointment, the cult moves as one again.
fail_text_en: The passed-over elder's faction pushes back.

label: 교주가 직접 작성한다
success_text_en: Airtight bylaws become the pillar of the cult.
fail_text_en: Even after several sleepless nights, you can't finish it.

label: 변호사에게 맡긴다
success_text_en: Legally solid bylaws are completed.
fail_text_en: The fee is steep, and the content is sloppy.

label: 공개 토론에 응한다
success_text_en: Your well-reasoned answers win everyone over.
fail_text_en: You're left speechless and lose face.

label: 따로 불러 이야기한다
success_text_en: The misunderstanding clears, and he bows his head.
fail_text_en: He brags that the cult leader dodged him.

label: 교주 옆자리를 내준다
label_en: Offer him the seat beside you
success_text_en: The notable is pleased and promises support.
fail_text_en: People gossip that you're sucking up.

label: 모든 자리는 평등하다며 거절한다
label_en: Refuse, saying every seat is equal
success_text_en: Followers respect you for keeping your principles.
fail_text_en: The notable leaves offended.

label: 엄격한 위계를 세운다
success_text: 명확한 위계에 교단이 질서 있게 움직입니다.
success_text_en: With a clear hierarchy, the cult runs in an orderly way.
fail_text_en: Squabbles over rank chill the atmosphere.

label: 봉사 중심의 직분만 둔다
success_text_en: Everyone gladly steps up to roles of service.
fail_text_en: Critics say the structure is too loose.

label: 검은 세단을 들인다
success_text_en: You exude dignity as you step out of the sedan.
fail_text_en: The papers call it an extravagance.

label: 낡은 차를 계속 탄다
success_text_en: Praise spreads for the frugal cult leader.
fail_text_en: The car keeps breaking down, and you suffer for it.

label: 목청껏 설교를 이어 간다
label_en: Keep preaching at the top of your lungs
success_text: 마이크 없이도 당신의 목소리가 예배당을 울립니다.
success_text_en: Even without a microphone, your voice fills the chapel.
fail_text_en: Your voice gives out before you can finish.

label: 잠시 찬양으로 시간을 번다
success_text_en: Everyone admires your quick-witted handling.
fail_text_en: The disorder continues.

label: 호칭을 받아들인다
success_text_en: The new title takes hold in the cult.
fail_text_en: Critics call it authoritarian.

label: '형제'로 부르라고 한다
success_text_en: Followers draw closer to you.
fail_text_en: The hierarchy loosens.

label: 권한으로 장부를 회수한다
label_en: Use your Authority to reclaim the books
success_text_en: The deacon hands over the books without a fuss.
fail_text_en: The deacon's supporters push back.

label: 회계 감사를 외부에 맡긴다
success_text_en: The transparent audit satisfies everyone.
fail_text_en: The audit cost is a burden.

label: 대형 초상화를 건다
success_text_en: Everyone grows solemn before the portrait.
fail_text_en: Accusations of idolatry pour in.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: The cult leader's humility becomes the talk of the town.
fail_text_en: Some followers are disappointed.

label: 교주의 상징을 넣는다
success_text_en: Followers wearing the emblem feel proud.
fail_text_en: People say it's tacky.

label: 신도 공모로 정한다
success_text_en: An emblem everyone cherishes is born.
fail_text_en: The winning entry stirs up controversy.

label: 그의 열정을 인정해 준다
success_text_en: The branch grows rapidly.
fail_text_en: Others start acting on their own too.

label: 엄하게 꾸짖고 지부를 거둔다
label_en: Rebuke him sternly and take back the branch
success_text_en: Order is restored in the cult.
fail_text_en: Followers leave along with the evangelist.

label: 당당히 발언한다
success_text_en: Your clear statement runs in the local paper.
fail_text_en: Under a barrage of questions, you babble incoherently.

label: 대변인을 보낸다
success_text_en: The spokesperson handles it without a hitch.
fail_text_en: People say the cult leader is hiding.

label: 모임을 찾아가 직접 대면한다
success_text: 그들은 당신의 진심에 다시 마음을 엽니다.
success_text_en: Your sincerity opens their hearts again.
fail_text_en: They publicly criticize the cult.

label: 모른 척 지켜본다
label_en: Pretend not to notice and watch
success_text_en: It was just a prayer group after all.
fail_text_en: The group keeps gaining strength.

label: 말씀 모음집을 낸다
label_en: Publish a collection of your sayings
success_text_en: The collection becomes the cult's guidebook.
fail_text_en: Critics say you're deifying yourself.

label: 성경을 먼저 외우라고 한다
label_en: Tell them to memorize scripture first
success_text_en: Followers immerse themselves in scripture study.
fail_text_en: Many followers are disappointed.

label: 교주가 직접 사회를 본다
success_text_en: Everyone admires your smooth hosting.
fail_text_en: Exhaustion leads to frequent slip-ups.

label: 제비뽑기로 정한다
success_text_en: No one complains about such a fair method.
fail_text_en: People say the cult leader dodged the decision.

label: 자서전을 쓴다
success_text: 책이 서점에 깔리고 교단의 이름이 알려집니다.
success_text_en: The book hits the shelves, and the cult's name spreads.
fail_text_en: The book doesn't sell and draws only bad reviews.

label: 아직 이르다며 사양한다
success_text_en: The publisher nods at your humble refusal.
fail_text_en: People say you missed your chance.

label: 교단 건물을 보수한다
success_text_en: Followers take pride in the refurbished building.
fail_text_en: The shoddy work has to be redone.

label: 일부를 이웃에게 나눈다
success_text: 쌀 포대를 받은 이웃들이 감사를 전합니다.
success_text_en: Neighbors who receive bags of rice express their thanks.
fail_text_en: People say the giving is just for show.

label: 감사히 받는다
success_text_en: The cult's coffers swell.
fail_text_en: The family shows up threatening to sue the cult.

label: 가족을 위해 거절한다
success_text: 신도의 가족이 교단을 다시 보게 됩니다.
success_text_en: The follower's family sees the cult in a new light.
fail_text_en: The follower is hurt and stubbornly insists.

label: 조용히 경찰에 신고한다
label_en: Quietly report it to the police
success_text_en: Even the police thank you for your honesty.
fail_text_en: Rumors spread that there's a criminal in the church.

label: 없던 일로 처리한다
label_en: Treat it as if it never happened
success_text_en: It quietly blows over.
fail_text_en: Later, the whole thing comes out.

label: 서점을 연다
success_text_en: The cult's books sell steadily at the bookstore.
fail_text_en: No customers come, and stock just piles up.

label: 위험하다며 미룬다
label_en: Put it off as too risky
success_text_en: The coffers stay safe.
fail_text_en: People say you missed your chance.

label: 계약한다
success_text_en: The magnificent chapel becomes the cult's symbol.
fail_text_en: The builder takes the money and vanishes.

label: 작게 짓자고 한다
success_text_en: A modest chapel stands just right.
fail_text_en: Construction drags on, and costs balloon.

label: 봉투에 이름을 쓰게 한다
success_text_en: Offerings rise, and the books are in order.
fail_text: 헌금 액수로 사람을 줄 세운다는 불만이 나옵니다.
fail_text_en: People complain that donors are ranked by amount.

label: 무기명 봉투로 한다
success_text_en: People give from the heart without pressure.
fail_text_en: Offerings actually drop.

label: 크게 연다
label_en: Hold it on a grand scale
success_text_en: The whole neighborhood comes to the bazaar.
fail_text_en: It rains, and no customers come.

label: 신도끼리 소박하게 연다
label_en: Hold a modest one among followers
success_text_en: Followers enjoy buying each other's goods.
fail_text_en: Almost nothing sells.

label: 연간 결산을 공개한다
success_text_en: Transparent accounts boost Offerings even more.
fail_text_en: Some expenditures get people talking.

label: 교주가 알아서 한다고 말한다
label_en: Say the cult leader will handle it
success_text_en: Followers stop asking.
fail_text_en: Suspicion builds, and Offerings fall.

label: 목돈을 예금한다
success_text_en: Interest accrues steadily.
fail_text_en: The bank fails, and you lose part of it.

label: 금고에 그대로 둔다
success_text_en: The money is kept safe.
fail_text_en: A thief breaks in, and you lose part of it.

label: 시장에 내다 판다
success_text_en: It fetches a good price, and the coffers fill.
fail_text_en: Prices crash, and you take a loss.

label: 양로원에 기부한다
label_en: Donate it to a nursing home
success_text_en: The elderly remember the cult's name.
fail_text_en: Shipping costs quite a bit.

label: 장로로 세운다
success_text_en: The coffers grow fat.
fail_text_en: Gossip spreads that he bought his position.

label: 헌금과 직분은 별개라고 말한다
label_en: Say Offerings and positions are separate
success_text_en: Followers respect you for keeping your principles.
fail_text_en: He takes back his donation and leaves.

label: 종을 판다
success_text_en: The coffers fill.
fail_text_en: With the bell gone silent, followers grieve.

label: 종은 교단의 목소리라며 거절한다
label_en: Refuse, calling the bell the cult's voice
success_text_en: The bell rings over the village again today.
fail_text_en: The junk dealer leaves grumbling.

label: 복사기를 직접 들인다
success_text_en: Printing in-house cuts costs dramatically.
fail_text_en: The copier breaks, and you pay for repairs.

label: 인쇄물을 줄인다
success_text_en: Keeping only what's needed makes things cleaner.
fail_text_en: Publicity falls short.

label: 용서하고 갚게 한다
label_en: Forgive him and have him pay it back
success_text_en: The deacon thanks you in tears and faithfully repays.
fail_text_en: The deacon vanishes without paying.

label: 공개적으로 문책한다
success_text_en: Discipline in the cult is restored.
fail_text_en: The atmosphere turns cold.

label: 장학 재단을 세운다
success_text_en: The scholarship students become the cult's pride.
fail_text_en: It's hard to run and soon closes.

label: 신도 자녀에게만 준다
label_en: Give it only to followers' children
success_text_en: Follower families are grateful.
fail_text_en: People call it exclusive.

label: 사들인다
success_text_en: You gain a second place of worship.
fail_text_en: You end up taking on its debts too.

label: 도와주되 사지는 않는다
label_en: Help them, but don't buy it
success_text_en: You build good relations with the neighboring church.
fail_text: 도움이 밑 빠진 독에 물 붓기가 됩니다.
fail_text_en: Your help vanishes like water into a bottomless jar.

label: 헌금 설교를 한다
success_text_en: Next week's Offerings rise sharply.
fail_text_en: People complain that you only talk about money.

label: 지출을 줄인다
success_text_en: By economizing, you keep the household afloat.
fail_text_en: Some are disappointed by the fewer events.

label: 주차장을 만든다
success_text_en: Weekday parking brings in tidy income.
fail_text_en: Friction arises with the residents.

label: 신도들의 쉼터로 만든다
label_en: Make it a rest area for followers
success_text_en: Chatter goes on beneath the shade of the trees.
fail_text_en: It's hard to maintain and soon goes to ruin.

label: 감사 예배 후 땅을 개간한다
label_en: Hold a thanksgiving service, then clear the land
success_text_en: The land yields its first harvest.
fail_text_en: The soil is barren, and it's nothing but toil.

label: 유족에게 돌려준다
label_en: Return it to the bereaved family
success_text_en: Moved, the family seeks out the cult.
fail_text_en: Some followers are disappointed.

label: 교주가 직접 나선다
success_text_en: Passersby who stop to listen come to the cult.
fail_text_en: The merchants chase you off.

label: 전도지를 나눠 준다
success_text_en: A few come by with tracts in hand.
fail_text_en: The tracts are tossed on the street.

label: 동아리를 세운다
success_text_en: Young followers flock to it.
fail_text_en: The student council opposes it, calling it a cult.

label: 조용히 성경 공부만 연다
label_en: Quietly hold only a Bible study
success_text: 진지한 학생 몇 명이 꾸준히 옵니다.
success_text_en: A few earnest students come regularly.
fail_text_en: No one comes.

label: 환영 잔치를 준비한다
success_text_en: New faces are moved by the warm hospitality.
fail_text_en: In the end, no one shows up.

label: 기대 없이 기다린다
success_text_en: Three people come and sign up.
fail_text_en: Even that follower is too embarrassed to show up.

label: 두 팔 벌려 맞는다
success_text_en: They find stability in their new home.
fail_text_en: Conflict arises with existing followers.

label: 천천히 적응하게 돕는다
success_text_en: One by one, they become part of the cult's family.
fail_text_en: Some grow tired of waiting and leave.

label: 큰 광고를 낸다
success_text_en: People who saw the ad send inquiries.
fail_text_en: There's no response at all.

label: 작은 안내문만 낸다
success_text_en: A few people quietly come by.
fail_text_en: The notice gets buried.

label: 야간 예배를 연다
success_text_en: Weary workers find comfort.
fail_text_en: You collapse from overwork.

label: 교회를 쉼터로 개방한다
label_en: Open the church as a shelter
success_text_en: Workers stop in to rest and stay for the service.
fail_text_en: Upkeep costs quite a bit.

label: 교주가 직접 가서 설교한다
success_text_en: The first gathering forms in the neighboring village.
fail_text_en: The villagers coldly turn away.

label: 신도들끼리 다녀오게 한다
label_en: Send the followers on their own
success_text_en: Followers gain confidence in proselytizing.
fail_text_en: They come back empty-handed.

label: 매일 아침 차를 나눈다
success_text: 차 한 잔에 이야기가 오가고 발길이 이어집니다.
success_text_en: Over cups of tea, conversations flow and visitors keep coming.
fail_text: 공짜 차만 마시고 가는 이가 대부분입니다.
fail_text_en: Most just drink the free tea and leave.

label: 주일에만 나눈다
success_text_en: A few regulars appear.
fail_text_en: No one stops by.

label: 유명 강사를 부른다
success_text_en: Crowds pour into the revival.
fail_text_en: The speaker teaches the Doctrine all wrong.

label: 교주가 직접 부흥회를 연다
success_text_en: Your passion brings in new followers.
fail_text_en: You overdo it and come down with aches and fever.

label: 떡을 들고 찾아간다
success_text_en: The family starts coming to the cult next Sunday.
fail_text_en: They say they've already joined another church.

label: 교회 안내 편지를 보낸다
label_en: Send a letter introducing the church
success_text_en: The family comes by, letter in hand.
fail_text_en: The letter goes unanswered.

label: 마당을 내주고 함께 뛴다
label_en: Open the yard and play with them
success_text_en: Even the children's parents come to the church.
fail_text_en: A window gets smashed.

label: 예배 후에만 쓰게 한다
success_text_en: The children kick a ball around after the service.
fail_text_en: The children go somewhere else.

label: 통역을 구해 함께 예배한다
label_en: Find an interpreter and worship together
success_text: 낯선 땅의 이들이 교단에서 가족을 찾습니다.
success_text_en: People from a foreign land find family in the cult.
fail_text_en: Cultural differences cause misunderstandings.

label: 식사만 함께 나눈다
success_text_en: Shared meals become a bridge.
fail_text_en: The food doesn't suit them, and they leave it uneaten.

label: 전도 주간을 선포한다
success_text: 온 교단이 전도에 나서 신도가 늘어납니다.
success_text_en: The whole cult goes out proselytizing, and followers increase.
fail_text_en: Forced outreach wears the followers out.

label: 떠난 이들을 찾아간다
success_text_en: Those who return greet you in tears.
fail_text_en: Doors are slammed in your face.

label: 쉬운 이름을 덧붙인다
success_text_en: People remember the cult more easily.
fail_text_en: People say its identity has been diluted.

label: 처음 이름을 지킨다
success_text_en: Followers grow more attached to the name.
fail_text: 낯선 이름에 발길을 돌리는 이가 있습니다.
fail_text_en: Some are put off by the unfamiliar name.

label: 부스를 차리고 공연한다
label_en: Set up a booth and perform
success_text_en: The cult's name spreads at the festival.
fail_text_en: The performance is a mess and becomes a laughingstock.

label: 전단지만 돌린다
success_text_en: A few people show interest.
fail_text_en: The flyers blow away in the wind.

label: 심방 팀을 꾸린다
success_text_en: Forgotten followers return.
fail_text_en: Many find the visits a nuisance.

label: 명부를 정리한다
success_text_en: The true count of followers becomes clear.
fail_text_en: Those removed from the roll feel hurt.

label: 큰 안내판을 세운다
success_text_en: More people find their way by the sign.
fail_text_en: The district office orders it torn down.

label: 작은 표지만 붙인다
label_en: Put up only a small marker
success_text_en: Those in the know find their way.
fail_text_en: No one notices it.

label: 성대하게 준비한다
success_text_en: Invited families sign up one by one.
fail_text_en: The families say they're busy and don't come after all.

label: 평소처럼 예배한다
success_text: 자연스러운 분위기가 오히려 좋다는 말을 듣습니다.
success_text_en: People say the natural atmosphere is actually better.
fail_text_en: The families are bored.

label: 천막을 세운다
success_text_en: Weary families find comfort in the tent.
fail_text_en: The hospital complains you're obstructing business.

label: 병원 원목실과 협력한다
success_text_en: The official partnership earns trust.
fail_text_en: The procedures are complicated, and nothing comes of it.

label: 교주가 직접 집필한다
success_text_en: The catechism becomes the basic text for training followers.
fail_text_en: Contradictions are pointed out, and it must be rewritten.

label: 신도들과 함께 만든다
success_text: 함께 만든 문답서에 모두가 애착을 갖습니다.
success_text_en: Everyone is attached to the catechism they made together.
fail_text_en: Opinions split, and nothing gets done.

label: 성실히 답한다
success_text_en: Your clear answer convinces the seminary student to join the cult.
fail_text_en: You can't answer and lose face.

label: 다음에 답하겠다고 한다
success_text: 며칠 연구한 끝에 답을 찾아 냅니다.
success_text_en: After days of study, you find the answer.
fail_text_en: Word spreads that you dodged the question.

label: 교주가 정한다
success_text_en: That sentence becomes the cult's motto.
fail_text_en: People say it's too difficult.

label: 공모로 정한다
success_text_en: Followers proudly recite the motto.
fail_text_en: The winning entry contradicts the Doctrine.

label: 원어 공부를 시작한다
success_text_en: The depth of the original text seeps into your sermons.
fail_text_en: You make no progress and give up.

label: 번역본을 여러 개 비교한다
success_text_en: You discover new meaning in the differences between translations.
fail_text_en: It only confuses you more.

label: 교리 공개 강좌를 연다
success_text_en: The lecture clears up misunderstandings.
fail_text_en: The lecture turns into a battleground of debate.

label: 두 사람을 따로 가르친다
success_text_en: Both of them change their minds.
fail_text_en: You're accused of favoritism.

label: 번역 모임을 만든다
success_text_en: The wisdom of the Church Fathers seeps into the cult.
fail_text_en: The translation is a mess and becomes a laughingstock.

label: 요약본만 만든다
success_text_en: The short text gets read by followers.
fail_text_en: The summary distorts the original meaning.

label: 그림책을 펴낸다
success_text_en: The children learn the Doctrine through the picture book.
fail_text_en: The pictures are so scary the children burst into tears.

label: 주일학교 교재로만 쓴다
label_en: Use it only as Sunday school material
success_text_en: The children enjoy learning.
fail_text_en: Teachers say it's hard to use.

label: 전통 예식을 되살린다
success_text_en: The solemn service makes followers reverent.
fail_text_en: People complain it's too stiff.

label: 자유로운 형식으로 바꾼다
success_text_en: Young followers enjoy the services.
fail_text_en: Critics call it frivolous.

label: 12주 과정을 연다
success_text_en: Graduates become the core of the cult.
fail_text_en: Dropouts pile up.

label: 짧은 특강만 연다
success_text_en: Many attend the casual lectures.
fail_text_en: People say they lack depth.

label: 풍습을 금지한다
success_text_en: The Doctrine is set straight.
fail_text_en: Followers who object leave.

label: 풍습에 새 의미를 입힌다
label_en: Give the custom a new meaning
success_text_en: The old custom becomes part of the cult's culture.
fail_text_en: Critics say the Doctrine has been muddied.

label: 자료를 모두 공개한다
success_text_en: The paper introduces the cult to academia.
fail_text_en: The paper comes out with criticism in it.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: The cult's inner workings stay quietly protected.
fail_text_en: It gives an impression of secrecy.

label: CD를 배포한다
success_text_en: Followers strengthen their faith listening to sermons at home.
fail_text_en: The poor sound quality draws complaints.

label: 설교는 예배당에서 들어야 한다고 한다
label_en: Say sermons should be heard in the chapel
success_text_en: Service attendance rises.
fail_text_en: Followers who live far away feel let down.

label: 시험 제도를 만든다
success_text_en: The quality of office holders rises.
fail_text_en: Those who fail the exam are hurt.

label: 추천제로 한다
success_text_en: Office holders appointed on trust are devoted.
fail_text_en: Disputes arise over qualifications.

label: 현대어로 고친다
success_text_en: Young followers understand the prayers.
fail_text_en: The elders miss the old prayers.

label: 그대로 지킨다
success_text_en: The weight of tradition safeguards the faith.
fail_text_en: More people stop praying, saying it's too hard.

label: 번역을 시작한다
success_text_en: Overseas Koreans take an interest in the cult.
fail_text_en: The clumsy translation fails to convey the meaning.

label: 아직 이르다며 미룬다
success_text_en: You focus on refining Doctrine at home.
fail_text_en: People say you missed your chance.

label: 모든 신도에게 권한다
success_text_en: Followers who keep journals deepen their faith.
fail_text_en: They complain that it feels like homework.

label: 교주부터 써서 보여 준다
label_en: Write one yourself first as an example
success_text: 교주의 일지를 보며 신도들이 따라 씁니다.
success_text_en: Seeing your journal, followers start writing their own.
fail_text_en: Writing every day is a burden.

label: 교리 선언문을 발표한다
success_text_en: A clear declaration dispels suspicion.
fail_text_en: The declaration's wording stirs up controversy instead.

label: 기존 교단과 대화한다
success_text_en: Dialogue clears up misunderstandings.
fail_text_en: You only confirm your differences.

label: 똑똑한 청년을 조수로 둔다
label_en: Take on a bright young man as your assistant
success_text_en: With the assistant's help, your sermons grow richer.
fail_text: 조수가 교주의 설교를 대신 쓴다는 소문이 납니다.
fail_text_en: Rumors spread that the assistant writes your sermons.

label: 혼자 준비한다
success_text: 고된 준비가 진심 어린 설교가 됩니다.
success_text_en: Grueling preparation yields a heartfelt sermon.
fail_text_en: You wear yourself out from overwork.

label: 책을 모아 도서실을 연다
label_en: Collect books and open a library
success_text_en: The library becomes a place of learning for followers.
fail_text_en: Books pile up, but no one visits.

label: 교주의 서재를 개방한다
label_en: Open your personal study to followers
success_text: 교주의 책을 빌려 읽으며 대화가 늘어납니다.
success_text_en: Followers borrow your books, and conversations multiply.
fail_text_en: Borrowed books never come back.

label: 교회 마당에서 함께 담근다
label_en: Make kimchi together in the churchyard
success_text_en: Kimchi-making full of laughter binds the community together.
fail_text_en: You hurt your back and suffer for days.

label: 홀몸 노인 몫까지 담근다
label_en: Make extra for elderly people living alone
success_text_en: The elderly are moved by the cult's care.
fail_text_en: The ingredients cost a lot.

label: 매주 애찬을 연다
label_en: Hold a fellowship meal every week
success_text_en: Eating from the same pot turns followers into family.
fail_text_en: The burden of preparation breeds complaints.

label: 한 달에 한 번만 연다
label_en: Hold it only once a month
success_text_en: At that pace, everyone enjoys it.
fail_text_en: Some wish there were more.

label: 구역 모임을 만든다
success_text_en: Deep fellowship grows in each small group.
fail_text_en: Rivalry springs up between the groups.

label: 교회에서만 모이게 한다
label_en: Have them meet only at church
success_text_en: Orderly gatherings are maintained.
fail_text_en: People say it's too rigid.

label: 온 교단이 집 짓기에 나선다
label_en: Rally the whole cult to build the house
success_text_en: Before the new house, everyone joins hands.
fail_text_en: Someone gets hurt during construction.

label: 성금을 모아 전달한다
success_text_en: The donations help the family get back on their feet.
fail_text_en: The donations fall woefully short.

label: 사진 전시회를 연다
success_text_en: Faces from days gone by bring memories blooming back.
fail_text_en: Photos of those who left dampen the mood.

label: 사진을 주인들에게 돌려준다
label_en: Return the photos to their owners
success_text_en: The recipients express their thanks.
fail_text_en: Many photos never find their owners.

label: 교주도 함께 오른다
success_text: 정상에서 함께 드린 기도가 오래 남습니다.
success_text_en: The prayer offered together at the summit lingers long.
fail_text_en: You twist your ankle and are carried down on someone's back.

label: 젊은 신도들만 보낸다
success_text_en: The young people return with stronger friendships.
fail_text_en: The elders feel left out.

label: 연합 체육대회를 연다
success_text_en: Sweating together dissolves old grudges.
fail_text_en: The games grow heated, and the quarrel worsens.

label: 대표들을 불러 화해시킨다
success_text_en: The representatives shake hands and make peace.
fail_text: 교주가 한쪽 편을 들었다는 말이 나옵니다.
fail_text_en: People say the cult leader took sides.

label: 합창단을 만든다
success_text_en: In harmony, they come to understand one another.
fail_text_en: Sheet music and costumes cost money.

label: 성가대에 합류하게 한다
label_en: Have them join the church choir
success_text_en: The existing choir grows fuller.
fail_text_en: Friction arises with the existing members.

label: 교회에서 명절 잔치를 연다
label_en: Hold a holiday feast at the church
success_text_en: Lonely followers spend the holiday together.
fail_text_en: Poorly prepared, it feels empty.

label: 교주의 집으로 초대한다
success_text_en: Followers are moved by the meal at your table.
fail_text_en: Hosting guests wears you out.

label: 험담에 대해 설교한다
success_text_en: Followers reflect on themselves.
fail_text_en: Those who feel called out push back.

label: 개인적으로 타이른다
success_text_en: The gossiper apologizes.
fail_text_en: He holds a grudge.

label: 예배 중에 나눔 시간을 넣는다
label_en: Add a sharing time to the service
success_text_en: Learning each other's pain brings them closer.
fail_text_en: Some worry their private lives will get around.

label: 기도 쪽지함을 둔다
label_en: Set up a prayer request box
success_text_en: Anonymous prayers warm the cult.
fail_text_en: Hardly any notes come in.

label: 교단 잔치로 축하한다
success_text_en: The whole cult blesses the bride and groom.
fail_text_en: The two families quarrel over costs.

label: 교주가 주례를 맡는다
success_text: 교주의 축복 속에 새 가정이 탄생합니다.
success_text_en: A new family is born under your blessing.
fail_text_en: You misspeak during the wedding address.

label: 교회 뒤에 텃밭을 일군다
label_en: Plant a garden behind the church
success_text_en: You set a fellowship meal with vegetables grown together.
fail_text_en: Pests destroy the harvest.

label: 화분 나눔만 한다
success_text_en: Small potted plants grow in every home.
fail_text_en: The plants quickly wither.

label: 교주가 중재한다
success_text_en: The debt is settled, and the two reconcile.
fail_text_en: Both of them resent you.

label: 교단 기금으로 대신 갚는다
label_en: Pay it off from the cult's fund
success_text_en: Both are grateful to the cult.
fail_text: 다른 이들도 돈 문제를 들고 옵니다.
fail_text_en: Others start bringing their money problems too.

label: '말동무 짝'을 맺어 준다
label_en: Pair them up as conversation partners
success_text_en: Friendships sprout across generations.
fail_text_en: Only awkwardness remains.

label: 세대별 모임을 따로 만든다
label_en: Create separate groups for each generation
success_text_en: Faith grows in groups where each feels at ease.
fail_text_en: People say the cult has split.

label: 모두 함께 청소한다
success_text_en: In the spotless chapel, everyone shares a sense of pride.
fail_text_en: The dust sets off endless coughing.

label: 청소 업체를 부른다
success_text_en: The spotless chapel welcomes guests.
fail_text_en: The cleaners damage a sacred relic.

label: 연탄 나르기 봉사를 한다
success_text_en: Faces smudged black, you all laugh together.
fail_text_en: Someone slips on the ice and gets hurt.

label: 교단 기금으로 연탄을 산다
label_en: Buy briquettes with the cult's fund
success_text_en: Families who spent a warm winter are grateful.
fail_text_en: Briquette prices soar, and there's not enough.

label: 이름표를 달게 한다
success_text_en: Calling each other by name brings people closer.
fail_text_en: Many people lose their name tags.

label: 신도 소개 시간을 갖는다
success_text_en: You learn each other's stories.
fail_text_en: Some find introducing themselves stressful.

label: 문을 활짝 열고 취재에 응한다
label_en: Throw the doors open to the press
success_text_en: A favorable article runs.
fail_text_en: The article portrays the cult as a sham.

label: 정중히 거절한다
success_text_en: Quiet daily life goes on.
fail_text: 숨기는 게 많다는 추측 기사가 납니다.
fail_text_en: A speculative article claims you have a lot to hide.

label: 매주 참여한다
success_text_en: Residents are grateful for the cleaner streets.
fail_text_en: Colds go around in the foul weather.

label: 한 번만 크게 한다
success_text_en: News spreads along with photos.
fail_text_en: People call it a publicity stunt.

label: 방음 공사를 한다
success_text_en: The resident is moved by the cult's consideration.
fail_text_en: Sound still leaks out even after the work.

label: 찾아가 사과하고 떡을 돌린다
label_en: Visit to apologize and hand out rice cakes
success_text_en: You and the resident make up with a smile.
fail_text_en: The resident refuses the rice cakes.

label: 표창식에 참석한다
success_text_en: News of the award makes the cult's name shine.
fail_text_en: The selection process stirs up controversy.

label: 공을 신도들에게 돌린다
label_en: Give the credit to your followers
success_text_en: Followers feel proud.
fail_text_en: People say you're too humble.

label: 공개 해명회를 연다
success_text_en: Your calm explanation clears up the residents' misunderstanding.
fail_text_en: The session turns into a public denunciation.

label: 선행으로 답한다
success_text_en: Quiet good deeds outlast the rumors.
fail_text_en: The slander continues.

label: 강연을 맡는다
success_text_en: The students listen closely to your story.
fail_text_en: Parents complain about religious coercion.

label: 종교 이야기 없이 봉사 경험만 나눈다
label_en: Share only your volunteer experience, without religion
success_text_en: The plain, sincere talk is well received.
fail_text_en: People say it was boring.

label: 구호 봉사단을 보낸다
success_text_en: The cult's name shines at the relief site.
fail_text_en: Someone gets hurt while volunteering.

label: 구호 물품을 보낸다
success_text_en: The supplies reach the disaster victims.
fail_text_en: The supplies end up in the wrong place.

label: 공개적으로 치리한다
success_text_en: Strict handling preserves trust in the cult.
fail_text_en: Some object that it goes too far.

label: 조용히 상담하고 돕는다
success_text_en: The follower quits gambling and returns.
fail_text_en: The rumor grows, and the cult gets blamed too.

label: 환영하고 연단을 내준다
label_en: Welcome him and give him the podium
success_text_en: The cult's influence grows.
fail_text_en: Critics call it a political church.

label: 정치와 거리를 둔다
success_text_en: The cult earns trust for staying neutral.
fail_text_en: The district mayor is put out.

label: 축하 잔치를 연다
success_text_en: Parents express their thanks to the cult.
fail_text_en: The celebration costs money.

label: 공부방을 늘린다
success_text_en: More children gain a place to learn.
fail_text_en: There aren't enough teachers, and it turns into a mess.

label: 행사 규모를 줄인다
success_text_en: People warm to the cult for being considerate of neighbors.
fail_text_en: Your followers are disappointed.

label: 교통 안내 봉사자를 세운다
success_text_en: The orderly event wins praise.
fail_text_en: A volunteer and a driver get into a dispute.

label: 출연한다
success_text: 방송 이후 교단의 이름이 전국에 알려집니다.
success_text_en: After the broadcast, the cult's name is known nationwide.
fail_text_en: The edited broadcast makes the cult look ridiculous.

label: 자료만 보낸다
success_text_en: A short but positive feature airs.
fail_text_en: The materials are used in a distorted way.

label: 매달 방문한다
success_text_en: The elderly eagerly count the days until the cult's people come.
fail_text_en: The visiting schedule wears you down.

label: 명절에만 방문한다
success_text: 명절 방문이 노인들에게 큰 기쁨이 됩니다.
success_text_en: Holiday visits bring the elderly great joy.
fail_text_en: They're left feeling you don't come often enough.

label: 외벽을 새로 칠한다
success_text_en: Residents warm to the freshened-up building.
fail_text: 색이 너무 튀어 오히려 놀림을 받습니다.
fail_text_en: The color is so loud you get teased for it.

label: 신도들과 함께 벽화를 그린다
label_en: Paint a mural with your followers
success_text_en: The mural becomes a neighborhood landmark.
fail_text_en: The painting skills fall short, and it becomes a laughingstock.

label: 설교에서 칭찬한다
success_text_en: Honesty becomes the cult's pride.
fail_text_en: He is embarrassed.

label: 지역 신문에 알린다
success_text_en: A heartwarming story runs in the paper.
fail_text_en: People say you're showing off.

label: 후원한다
success_text_en: The merchants see the cult as a dependable neighbor.
fail_text_en: The donation gets misused.

label: 봉사 인력으로 돕는다
success_text_en: The merchants are grateful for your hard work.
fail_text_en: The work is grueling, and you wear out.

label: 목사를 찾아가 대화한다
success_text_en: After talking, the pastor apologizes for the misunderstanding.
fail_text_en: You get even harsher words in return.

label: 무시하고 선행에 힘쓴다
label_en: Ignore it and focus on good deeds
success_text_en: The cult's fruits speak louder than words.
fail_text_en: The rumor spreads through the neighborhood.

label: 헌혈 버스를 부른다
label_en: Call in a blood donation bus
success_text_en: Dozens roll up their sleeves.
fail_text: 헌혈 후 어지러워 쓰러지는 이가 생깁니다.
fail_text_en: Someone faints from dizziness after donating.

label: 교주가 먼저 헌혈한다
success_text_en: Following your lead, followers line up.
fail_text_en: You suffer from anemia for days.
